# Figure 3. Heat Map: Proportion Delayed Mortality & Time to Min CC

```{r}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SIMPLIFIED: Use existing prop_delayed variable
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
prop_delayed_hm_simple <- plot_metrics_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(sev_MT07),
    EVT_GP_plot %in% evts_ordered,
    !is.na(prop_delayed)
  ) %>%
  group_by(EVT_GP_plot, sev_MT07) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prop_delayed = round(
      mean(prop_delayed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      1 # one decimal place
    ),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sev_MT07 = factor(
      sev_MT07,
      levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")
    ),
    EVT_GP_plot = factor(
      EVT_GP_plot,
      levels = rev(evts_ordered)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(n_obs >= 10)

head(prop_delayed_hm_simple)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SIMPLIFIED: Use existing min_year variable
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

time_to_min_hm_simple <- plot_metrics_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(sev_MT07),
    EVT_GP_plot %in% evts_ordered,
    !is.na(min_year),
    min_year > 0  # ensure valid years
  ) %>%
  group_by(EVT_GP_plot, sev_MT07) %>%
  summarise(
    median_years = round(median(min_year, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_years = round(mean(min_year, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sev_MT07 = factor(sev_MT07, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
    EVT_GP_plot = factor(EVT_GP_plot, levels = rev(evts_ordered))
  ) %>%
  filter(n_obs >= 10)

# ── Plot Heatmap A ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig3a_heatmap <- ggplot(
  prop_delayed_hm_simple,
  aes(x = sev_MT07, y = EVT_GP_plot, fill = mean_prop_delayed)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  # Tile labels with adaptive color
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(mean_prop_delayed, "%"),
      color = mean_prop_delayed > median(mean_prop_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    size     = 2.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Adaptive text color
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  
  # Color scale: 0% (white/low) to 100% (dark blue/high) delayed mortality
scale_fill_gradient2(
  low      = "#2C7BB6",   # cool blue
  mid      = "#F7F7F7",   # near-white
  high     = "#D7191C",   # warm red
  midpoint = 50,
  name     = "Proportion\nDelayed (%)",
  limits   = c(0, 100),
  n.breaks = 5,
  guide    = guide_colorbar(barwidth = unit(0.35, "cm"),
                            barheight = unit(3.0, "cm"), ticks = TRUE)
) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")) +
  
  labs(
    x        = "Burn severity",
    y        = NULL,
    subtitle = "Proportion of delayed mortality"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 8, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.line          = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks         = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "right",
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 7, face = "plain"),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.margin      = margin(0, 0, 0, 2, "pt"),
    panel.grid         = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey40"),
    plot.margin        = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, "pt")
  )

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEATMAP B: Time to Minimum Canopy Cover (years)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Calculate time to minimum canopy cover
time_to_min_hm <- master %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean",
    !is.na(sev_MT07),
    EVT_GP_plot %in% evts_ordered,
    delta_year >= 1 & delta_year <= 10
  ) %>%
  arrange(plot_key, delta_year) %>%
  group_by(plot_key) %>%
  # Find the year of minimum canopy cover
  mutate(
    min_cc = min(TRE, na.rm = TRUE),
    year_at_min = delta_year[which.min(TRE)]
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(year_at_min)) %>%
  
  # Aggregate by EVT and severity
  group_by(EVT_GP_plot, sev_MT07) %>%
  summarise(
    median_years_to_min = round(median(year_at_min, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_years_to_min = round(mean(year_at_min, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sev_MT07 = factor(sev_MT07, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
    EVT_GP_plot = factor(EVT_GP_plot, levels = rev(evts_ordered))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(median_years_to_min), n_obs >= 10)

# ── Plot Heatmap B ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig3b_heatmap <- ggplot(
  time_to_min_hm,
  aes(x = sev_MT07, y = EVT_GP_plot, fill = median_years_to_min)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  # Tile labels with adaptive color
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(median_years_to_min, "yr"),
      color = median_years_to_min > median(median_years_to_min, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    size     = 2.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Adaptive text color
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "black")) +

  # Heatmap B: 1-10 years, split at ~5.5
scale_fill_gradient2(
  low      = "#2C7BB6",
  mid      = "#F7F7F7",
  high     = "#D7191C",
  midpoint = 5.5,
  name     = "Years to\nMin CC",
  limits   = c(1, 10),
  n.breaks = 5,
  guide    = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      barheight = unit(3.0,  "cm"),
      ticks     = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")) +
  
  labs(
    x        = "Burn severity",
    y        = NULL,
    subtitle = "Median years post-fire to reach minimum canopy cover"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 8, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.line          = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks         = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "right",
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 7, face = "plain"),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.margin      = margin(0, 0, 0, 2, "pt"),
    panel.grid         = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey40"),
    plot.margin        = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, "pt")
  )

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COMBINE BOTH HEATMAPS SIDE-BY-SIDE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fig3_combined <- (fig3a_heatmap | fig3b_heatmap) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", family = "Arial")
    )
  )

# ── Preview ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig3_combined

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Double column width for side-by-side heatmaps
ggsave(

)

)
```

#Figure 5.
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIGURE: Immediate vs delayed canopy loss for ALL fires, ordered by the
# fire-level variable most strongly related to proportion of delayed mortality
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ── 0. EDIT: 
# Any predictor you don't have can be deleted from this list.
COL <- c(
  fire_id    = "Fire_ID",
  immediate  = "IFL_loss",       # immediate canopy loss (yr 0 -> yr 1)
  delayed    = "PAL_loss",       # delayed canopy loss (yr 1 -> minimum)
  fire_year  = "Ig_Year",
  fire_ha  = "BurnBndHa",
  elevation  = "elevation",      # UNSCALED versions, not *_sc
  dnbr       = "dNBR_yr1",
  cwd_post   = "def_postfire_5yr_mean",       # post-fire CWD anomaly, unscaled
  treecover  = "treecover2000",
  slope      = "slope"
)

# ── 1. Plot-level table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_df <- as.data.frame(plot_metrics_analysis) %>%
  rename(any_of(COL))

# keep burned clean plots only, if that label exists in this table
if ("Correct_Plot_Label_final" %in% names(plot_df)) {
  plot_df <- filter(plot_df, Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean")
}

# abs() guards against sign conventions (losses stored as negative numbers).
# Check that this matches Table 2 (mean immediate ~20, delayed ~19).
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(immediate = abs(immediate),
         delayed   = abs(delayed),
         total     = immediate + delayed,
         prop_delayed = delayed / total) %>%
  filter(total > 0, is.finite(prop_delayed))

# ── 2. Fire-level summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fire_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(fire_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_plots      = n(),
    immediate    = mean(immediate),
    delayed      = mean(delayed),
    prop_delayed = mean(prop_delayed),   # mean of plot proportions (matches Table 2)
    across(any_of(c("fire_ha", "fire_year")), first),
    across(any_of(c("elevation", "dnbr", "cwd_post", "treecover", "slope")),
           ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_plots >= 10)

cat("Fires plotted:", nrow(fire_df), "\n")   # expect ~175

# ── 3. Which fire-level variable best tracks proportion delayed? ──────────────
candidates <- intersect(c("fire_ha", "fire_year", "elevation", "dnbr",
                          "cwd_post", "treecover", "slope"), names(fire_df))

screen <- lapply(candidates, function(v) {
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(fire_df[[v]], fire_df$prop_delayed,
                                  method = "spearman"))
  data.frame(predictor = v, rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% arrange(desc(abs(rho)))

print(screen)
best <- screen$predictor[1]
cat("Ordering fires by:", best, "\n")
# NOTE: this is a univariate screen. Confirm with a multi-predictor model
# (e.g., lm or a random forest on fire_df) before choosing the x-axis.
# You can also override:  best <- "elevation"

pretty <- c(fire_ha = "Fire size (ha)", fire_year = "Fire year",
            elevation = "Mean elevation (m)", dnbr = "Mean dNBR",
            cwd_post = "Post-fire CWD anomaly (mm)",
            treecover = "Pre-fire tree cover (%)", slope = "Mean slope (°)")

# Diagnostic: all candidates vs proportion delayed
p_screen <- fire_df %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(candidates), names_to = "predictor", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(predictor = pretty[predictor]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, prop_delayed)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_plots), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, colour = "#E41A1C", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ predictor, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3), name = "Plots per fire") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean proportion of delayed mortality") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
print(p_screen)

# ── 4. Bar chart: one stacked bar per fire, ordered by `best` ─────────────────
fire_ord <- fire_df %>%
  arrange(.data[[best]]) %>%
  mutate(fire_id = factor(fire_id, levels = fire_id))

bars <- fire_ord %>%
  select(fire_id, immediate, delayed) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(immediate, delayed), names_to = "phase", values_to = "loss") %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("delayed", "immediate")))  # immediate on bottom

p_bars <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = bars, aes(fire_id, loss, fill = phase), width = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = fire_ord, aes(fire_id, prop_delayed * 100),
             shape = 18, size = 1.8, colour = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 100, name = "Proportion of delayed mortality")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(immediate = "#F5A623", delayed = "#4A90D9"),
                    breaks = c("delayed", "immediate"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = " canopy loss (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

# Strip underneath showing the ordering variable for each fire
p_pred <- ggplot(fire_ord, aes(fire_id, .data[[best]], group = 1)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) +
  labs(x = paste0("Fires (n = ", nrow(fire_ord), "), ordered by ", tolower(pretty[best])),
       y = pretty[best]) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
if (best == "fire_ha") p_pred <- p_pred + scale_y_log10()

fig_bars <- (p_bars / p_pred) + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
print(fig_bars)

ggsave("Fig_all_fires_delayed_bars.png", fig_bars,
       width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# ── 5. Help choosing a fire for the map figure ────────────────────────────────
# Large fires with many plots and a mix of outcomes make the best maps.
fire_df %>%
  arrange(desc(n_plots)) %>%
  select(fire_id, any_of(c("fire_ha", "fire_year")), n_plots, prop_delayed) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
# ── 6. Panel A: severity x elevation interaction (ordered beta model) ────────
library(emmeans)

grid <- as_tibble(emmeans(m3_ordered_beta,
                          ~ dNBR_sc | elevation_sc,
                          at = list(dNBR_sc  = c(-1, 0, 1),
                                    elevation_sc = c(-1, 0, 1)),
                          type = "response")) %>%
  rename(prop = response, se = SE) %>%
  mutate(elevation_band = factor(elevation_sc, levels = c(-1, 0, 1),
        labels = c("Low elevation (-1 SD)", "Mean elevation",
                   "High elevation (+1 SD)")))

elev_colors <- c("Low elevation (-1 SD)"  = "#D95F02",
                 "Mean elevation"          = "#666666",
                 "High elevation (+1 SD)" = "#1B9E77")

p_int <- ggplot(grid, aes(dNBR_sc, prop,
                          color = elevation_band, fill = elevation_band)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = prop - 1.96 * se, ymax = prop + 1.96 * se),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40",
             linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
                     labels = c("Low\n(-1 SD)", "Mean", "High\n(+1 SD)")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.34, 0.60), breaks = seq(0.35, 0.60, 0.05)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = elev_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = elev_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(tag = "A.",
       subtitle = "Model predictions at ±1 SD dNBR and elevation (shaded = 95% CI)",
       x = "Burn severity (dNBR)",
       y = "Predicted proportion of delayed mortality") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey40"))

p_bars2 <- p_bars + labs(tag = "B.")
p_pred2 <- p_pred + labs(tag = "C.")

theme_fig6 <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
    plot.tag      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_int         <- p_int         + theme_fig6

# (if you keep the separate strip: p_pred + theme_fig6)

fig6_combined <- p_int / (p_bars2 / p_pred2) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.5, 2))

fig6_combined

ggsave("Fig6_Climate_DelayedShare_Ecosphere.png", fig6_combined,
       width = 10, height = 8.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("Fig6_Climate_DelayedShare_Ecosphere.tiff", fig6_combined,
       width = 10, height = 8.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
# ── 3. Panel A: points for all three variables vs standardized CWD ─────────
PROP_W <- 50   # proportion 1.0 spans 50 pct points on the left axis

## long format: one row per fire per series; proportion rescaled to left axis
fire_long <- fire_df %>%
  select(fire_id, cwd_post_z, immediate, delayed, prop_delayed) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(immediate, delayed, prop_delayed),
               names_to = "series", values_to = "loss") %>%

cc_colors <- c("Immediate"          = "black",
               "Delayed"            = "grey50",
               "Proportion delayed" = "red4")

pA <- ggplot(fire_long, aes(x = cwd_post_z)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = PROP_W * 0.5, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(data = filter(fire_long, series == "Proportion delayed"),
              aes(y = loss_plot), method = "loess", se = FALSE,
              color = "red3", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(y = loss_plot, color = series), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cc_colors, name = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Canopy loss (% points)",
    breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 10),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / PROP_W, name = "Proportion of delayed mortality"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
  labs(x = "Post-fire CWD anomaly (SD, centered on 0)",
       tag = "A.",
       subtitle = "Fire means (n = 172); smooth line: proportion delayed (loess)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    plot.tag        = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey20"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin     = margin(10, 8, 4, 4)
  )
pA

# ── 4. Panel B: Eq. 3 predictions (fine grid) + observed points ─────────────
elev_colors <- c("Low (-1 SD)"  = "darkolivegreen4",
                 "Mean"         = "goldenrod",
                 "High (+1 SD)" = "cadetblue")

grid <- as_tibble(emmeans(m3_ordered_beta,
                          ~ dNBR_sc | elevation_sc,
                          at = list(dNBR_sc  = seq(-2.5, 2.5, 0.25),
                                    elevation_sc = c(-1, 0, 1)),
                          type = "response")) %>%
  rename(prop = response, se = SE) %>%
  mutate(elevation_band = factor(elevation_sc, levels = c(-1, 0, 1),
        labels = c("Low (-1 SD)", "Mean", "High (+1 SD)")))

qb <- quantile(plot_df$elevation_sc, c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)

obs <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(elev_bin = cut(elevation_sc,
                        breaks = c(-Inf, qb[1], qb[2], Inf),
                        labels = c("Low (-1 SD)", "Mean", "High (+1 SD)")))

pB <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = obs,
             aes(x = dNBR_sc, y = prop_delayed, color = elev_bin),
             size = 0.6, alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_ribbon(data = grid,
              aes(x = dNBR_sc, ymin = prop - 1.96 * se, ymax = prop + 1.96 * se,
                  fill = elevation_band),
              alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  geom_line(data = grid,
            aes(x = dNBR_sc, y = prop, color = elevation_band),
            linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey20",
             linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-2, 2, by = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2.5, 2.5), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = elev_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = elev_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(tag = "B.",
       subtitle = "Lines: Eq. 3 predictions ± 95% CI; points: plots by elevation tercile",
       x = "dNBR Burn severity (SD, centered on 0)",
       y = "Proportion of delayed mortality") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title    = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    plot.tag      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey20"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text   = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin   = margin(10, 4, 4, 4)
  )

# ── 5. Combine and save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig5_new <- (pA | pB) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.15))

fig5_new
ggsave("Fig5_A_B_points.png", fig5_new, width = 10, height = 4.8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("Fig5_A_B_points.pdf", fig5_new, width = 10, height = 4.8, device = cairo_pdf)
```

#Figure 6.
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIGURE: one large fire, three panels
#   A. measured dNBR   B. delayed canopy loss   C. proportion delayed mortality
# Input: GeoTIFF exported by gee_fire_delayed_mortality_maps.js
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(ggspatial) # helps to get a N arrow and scale bar

## helper so every panel gets identical decorations
add_decor <- function(p, scale = TRUE, north = TRUE) {
  if (north) {
    p <- p + annotation_north_arrow(
      location   = "tr",            # top-right; use "tl" if the legend sits there
      which_north = "true",
      height     = unit(0.8, "cm"), width = unit(0.8, "cm"),
      style      = north_arrow_orienteering(text_size = 6))
  }
  if (scale) {
    p <- p + annotation_scale(
      location  = "bl",             # bottom-left
      width_hint = 0.25,            # bar spans 25% of panel width
      height    = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      bar_cols  = c("grey20", "white"),
      text_size = 6)
  }
  p
}

r <- rast("delayed_maps_CEDAR.tif")   # EDIT filename
names(r) <- c("dNBR", "immediate", "delayed", "total", "prop_delayed")
r[r == -9999] <- NA

# ── Shared look ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theme_map <- theme_void(base_size = 9) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.width = unit(1.3, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0))

# Panel A: measured dNBR
pA <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = r$dNBR, aes(fill = dNBR)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#1A6B1A", "#7DC142", "#F2E83A", "#F29A1F", "#D7191C", "#67000D"),
    values  = scales::rescale(c(-50, 150, 250, 350, 450, 550, 650), from = c(-50, 650)),
    limits  = c(-50, 650), oob = scales::squish, na.value = NA, name = "dNBR") +
  labs(title = "A. Measured burn severity (dNBR)") +
  theme_map

# Panel B: delayed canopy loss, % points (year 1 -> minimum)
pB <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = r$delayed, aes(fill = delayed)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1, limits = c(0, 40),
                       oob = scales::squish, na.value = NA,
                       name = "Delayed canopy loss (% points)") +
  labs(title = "B. Delayed canopy loss") +
  theme_map

# Panel C: proportion delayed; diverging at 0.5 (the immediate- vs delayed-dominant threshold)
# Colours match the immediate (orange) / delayed (blue) bars in the all-fires figure.
pC <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = r$prop_delayed, aes(fill = prop_delayed)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4A90D9", mid = "grey95", high = "#F5A623", 
                       midpoint = 0.5, limits = c(0, 1), na.value = NA,
                       name = "Proportion of delayed mortality") +
  labs(title = "C. Proportion of delayed mortality") +
  theme_map

# You cannot add a 95% CI to the panels because each pixel is a single measured value (dNBR, canopy loss), not an estimate with a sampling distribution, so there is nothing to hang an error bar on
pA <- add_decor(pA)   # scale bar + N arrow on panel A
pB <- add_decor(pB, north = FALSE)   # scale bar only
pC <- add_decor(pC, north = FALSE)

fig_map <- (pA | pB | pC) &
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                                barwidth = unit(4, "cm")))

fig_map <- fig_map + plot_annotation(
  title = "Iron and Alps Complexes (Cedar) Fire, 2008 (~10,230 ha)") #,
  #caption = "Panel C is masked where total canopy loss < 10 percentage points or pre-fire tree cover < 10%.")

ggsave("Fig_fire_map_three_panel.png", fig_map, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

ggsave("Fig_fire_map_three_panel.png", fig_map,
       width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VALIDATION (recommended): does the raster reproduce your plot-level numbers?

v   <- vect(pts, geom = c("long", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326") %>% project(crs(r))
```

mean immediate (year-1) canopy loss observed within each dNBR severity class – that is empirically what a 1-year assessment reports. The comparison then becomes year-1 observed loss vs. year-10 observed loss within the same class, which is exactly the "1-year MTBS vs. extended assessment" contrast, with no invented constants.

delayed mortality as pre-fire CC minus minimum CC, with time to minimum canopy cover as the timing response. Total loss is therefore baseline − minimum canopy cover, evaluated whenever that minimum occurs.
```{r}
library(dplyr)

df <- plot_metrics_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(sev_class), !is.na(EVT_GP_plot)) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1-year view: what an MTBS-style assessment reports
    imm_rel   = 100 * IFL_loss / baseline_final,

    # Total loss: pre-fire baseline MINUS minimum canopy cover,
    # consistent with delayed mortality = prefire CC - min CC
    total_rel = 100 * (baseline_final - min_canopy) / baseline_final,

    class_yr1   = if_else(imm_rel   <= 50, "Low (1-yr)",   "High (1-yr)"),
    class_total = if_else(total_rel <= 50, "Low (total)",  "High (total)"),
    reclassified = class_yr1 != class_total,
    drought_bin  = cut(def_post_sc, c(-Inf, -1, 0, Inf),
                       labels = c("Wet anomaly", "Near-normal", "Dry anomaly"))
  )

summary(df)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    cat_yr1      = if_else(imm_rel   <= 50, "Low", "High"),
    cat_total    = if_else(total_rel <= 50, "Low", "High"),
    reclassified = cat_yr1 != cat_total
  )

count(df, reclassified)
addmargins(with(df, table(cat_yr1, cat_total)))   # this is the new confusion matrix

```

For the ~75% of plots where canopy declined, the reference is the pre-fire baseline and everything behaves as the Methods currently describes. For plots whose canopy grew between baseline and year 1, the reference is the year-1 canopy: they have zero immediate loss by definition, and their delayed decline is measured from the post-fire peak. That is a defensible convention (it never counts canopy increase as negative loss), but it must be stated. Suggested Methods sentence: "Immediate canopy loss was the decline from the pre-fire baseline (5-year mean) to post-fire year 1, floored at zero for plots whose canopy increased; total canopy loss was measured from the same reference (the greater of the pre-fire baseline and the year-1 canopy) to each plot's minimum canopy cover. The low/high classification threshold (≤50% vs. >50%) was applied to losses relative to this reference."

```{r}
# How many plots are in the regrowth class (immediate loss = 0 via the clamp)?
sum(df$canopy_yr1 > df$baseline_final)          # expect ~1,247

# Where do they sit? (sanity check on the ecology)
df %>%
  mutate(regrowth = canopy_yr1 > baseline_final) %>%
  count(regrowth, EVT_GP_plot) %>%
  arrange(regrowth, desc(n))

```
A total of 1,338 burned plots (11.8%) had year-1 canopy cover exceeding the 5-year pre-fire baseline; for these plots, immediate canopy loss was zero by definition and total canopy loss was measured from the year-1 canopy. This class occurred across all vegetation types and was most frequent in non-forest and shrubland systems.

```{r}
df %>%
  mutate(regrowth = canopy_yr1 > baseline_final) %>%
  count(regrowth, prefire_hansen_loss) %>%
  group_by(regrowth) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n))

```

## Framing: it's the loss class that reclassifies, not the severity label
The dNBR-based severity class (low/moderate/high) is fixed at year 1 – what changes is the mortality/loss class once delayed decline is added. So your transition table (immediate-loss class → total-loss class) is the right construction, and the severity product (sev_class vs sev_MT07) enters as a stratifying variable, not as an axis. Decide which severity variable stratifies the figure: sev_class (the MTBS product, more literal for the "current MTBS assessment" framing, n = 11,340) or sev_MT07 (consistency with all your models, n = 11,321).

```{r}
library(ggalluvial)
library(dplyr)

rate_levels <- c("Wet anomaly", "Near-normal", "Dry anomaly")
fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")

# ── flow colors + legend labels (pooled counts, from df) ────────────────────
flow_colors <- c("Remained low canopy loss"  = "#9ECAE1",
                 "Reclassified: low to high" = "goldenrod2",
                 "Remained high canopy loss" = "#4D4D4D")

n_ll <- sum(df$cat_yr1 == "Low"  & df$cat_total == "Low")
n_lh <- sum(df$cat_yr1 == "Low"  & df$cat_total == "High")
n_hh <- sum(df$cat_yr1 == "High" & df$cat_total == "High")

flow_labels <- c(
  "Remained low canopy loss"  = sprintf("Remained low canopy loss (n = %s)",  fmt(n_ll)),
  "Reclassified: low to high" = sprintf("Reclassified: low to high (n = %s)", fmt(n_lh)),
  "Remained high canopy loss" = sprintf("Remained high canopy loss (n = %s)", fmt(n_hh))
)

# ── CHANGED: define flow INSIDE the pipeline, then count ────────────────────
flows <- df %>%
  mutate(
    flow = case_when(
      cat_yr1 == "Low"  & cat_total == "Low"  ~ "Remained low canopy loss",
      cat_yr1 == "Low"  & cat_total == "High" ~ "Reclassified: low to high",
      cat_yr1 == "High" & cat_total == "High" ~ "Remained high canopy loss"
    ),
    flow = factor(flow, levels = c("Remained low canopy loss",
                                   "Reclassified: low to high",
                                   "Remained high canopy loss"))
  ) %>%
  count(drought_bin, cat_yr1, cat_total, flow, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(drought_bin) %>%
  mutate(bin_n = sum(n),
         pct   = 100 * n / bin_n) %>%          # each facet sums to 100%
  ungroup()

# ── per-facet stratum percentages for the labels ────────────────────────────
s1 <- flows %>% group_by(drought_bin, cat_yr1) %>%
  summarise(n1 = sum(n), bin_n = first(bin_n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p1 = 100 * n1 / bin_n)
s2 <- flows %>% group_by(drought_bin, cat_total) %>%
  summarise(n2 = sum(n), bin_n = first(bin_n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p2 = 100 * n2 / bin_n)

flows <- flows %>%
  left_join(s1, by = c("drought_bin", "cat_yr1")) %>%
  left_join(s2, by = c("drought_bin", "cat_total")) %>%
  mutate(
    lab_yr1   = paste0(cat_yr1, " canopy loss\n",
                       sprintf("%.1f%%", p1), " (n = ", fmt(n1), ")"),
    lab_total = paste0(cat_total, " canopy loss\n",
                       sprintf("%.1f%%", p2), " (n = ", fmt(n2), ")")
  )

# keep Low above High within each facet
order_labs <- function(x) {
  lv <- unique(x)
  factor(x, levels = lv[order(ifelse(grepl("^Low", lv), 1, 2), lv)])
}
flows$lab_yr1   <- order_labs(flows$lab_yr1)
flows$lab_total <- order_labs(flows$lab_total)

# facet strips carry the bin's n
bin_ns <- df %>% count(drought_bin, name = "bin_n")
strip_lab <- function(bin) {
  sprintf("%s\n(n = %s)", bin, fmt(bin_ns$bin_n[match(bin, bin_ns$drought_bin)]))
}

fig8a <- ggplot(flows, aes(y = pct, axis1 = lab_yr1, axis2 = lab_total)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = flow), width = 1/3, alpha = 0.85, knot.pos = 0.4) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/3, fill = "grey95", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
            size = 2.4, lineheight = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(drought_bin, levels = rate_levels), nrow = 1,
             labeller = as_labeller(strip_lab)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = flow_colors, labels = flow_labels, name = NULL) +
  labs(y = "Percent of plots in drought bin",
       x = "1-year assessment  \u2192  extended (total) assessment") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom")

fig8a

ggsave("Fig8A_Alluvial_faceted.png", fig8a,
       width = 10.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(broom.mixed)
library(dplyr)

# ---- helper: pull fixed effects + 95% CI from each model ----
get_coefs <- function(model, exponentiate = FALSE) {
  tid <- tidy(model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95)
  if (exponentiate) {
    tid <- tid %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), exp))
  }
  tid
}

# Replace with your actual model objects
coefs_eq1 <- get_coefs(m1_sc)                 # percentage-point scale
coefs_eq2 <- get_coefs(m2_tweedie, exponentiate = TRUE)   # odds ratios
coefs_eq3 <- get_coefs(m3_ordered_beta)                  # ordered beta logit scale
coefs_eq4 <- get_coefs(m_aft_int, exponentiate = TRUE)   # time ratios

# ---- cleaning: drop intercept, relabel terms, set factor order ----
clean <- function(d, keep_levels) {
  d %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(term = factor(term, levels = keep_levels))
}

# Define a shared term order so panels align
terms_ordered <- c("dNBR_sc", "elevation_sc", "treecover_sc",
                   "def_pre_sc","def_post_sc", "slope_sc",
                   "EVT_GP_plot")

# ---- panels ----

             aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high,
                      color = p.value < 0.05), size = 0.35) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey55", "black"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Effect on immediate loss (percentage points)", y = NULL,
       tag = "A") + theme_bw(base_size = 11)

p2 <- ggplot(clean(coefs_eq2, terms_ordered),

  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high,
                      color = p.value < 0.05), size = 0.35) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey55", "black"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio (log scale)", y = NULL, tag = "B") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

p3 <- ggplot(clean(coefs_eq3, terms_ordered),
             aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high,
                      color = p.value < 0.05), size = 0.35) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey55", "black"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Ordered beta coefficient", y = NULL, tag = "C") +

p4 <- ggplot(clean(coefs_eq4, terms_ordered),
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(broom.mixed)

get_coefs <- function(model, exponentiate = FALSE) {
  tid <- tidy(model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95)

  }
  tid
}

coefs_eq1 <- get_coefs(m1_sc)
coefs_eq2 <- get_coefs(m2_tweedie, exponentiate = TRUE)
coefs_eq3 <- get_coefs(m3_ordered_beta)
coefs_eq4 <- get_coefs(m_aft_int, exponentiate = TRUE)   # Log(scale) dropped below

# ---- label map (exact term names -> display labels) ----
veg <- c("CA Coastal Redwood", "CA Mesic Mixed Conifer",
         "CA Mixed Evergreen Hardwood", "CA Mixed Oak Woodland",
         "CA Montane Conifer", "Chaparral Shrubland",
         "Non-forest", "Other Forest", "Riparian")

label_map <- c(
  "dNBR_sc"          = "dNBR (1 SD)",
  "elevation_sc"     = "Elevation (1 SD)",
  "treecover_sc"     = "Tree cover (1 SD)",
  "def_pre_sc"       = "Pre-fire drought (1 SD)",
  "def_post_sc"      = "Post-fire drought (1 SD)",
  "slope_sc"         = "Slope (1 SD)",
  "sev_MT07Moderate" = "Moderate severity",
  "sev_MT07High"     = "High severity",
  "IFL_loss"         = "Immediate canopy loss (yr 1)"   # rename to what IFL_loss actually is
)

term_lab <- function(x) {
  x <- str_remove(x, "^EVT_GP_plot")   # vegetation types
  x <- dplyr::recode(x, !!!label_map)
  x
}

# Shared display order: severity, vegetation types, continuous predictors
shared_levels <- c("Moderate severity", "High severity",
                   veg,
                   "Immediate canopy loss (yr 1)",
                   "dNBR (1 SD)", "Elevation (1 SD)", "Tree cover (1 SD)",
                   "Pre-fire drought (1 SD)", "Post-fire drought (1 SD)",
                   "Slope (1 SD)")

clean <- function(d) {
  out <- d %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)",
           !str_detect(term, ":"),      # interactions -> supplement panel
           term != "Log(scale)") %>%    # AFT nuisance parameter
    mutate(lab = term_lab(term))
  # safety: fail loudly if any term is unmapped instead of plotting "NA"
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(match(out$lab, shared_levels))))
  out %>% mutate(lab = factor(lab, levels = shared_levels))
}

# ---- panels ----
panel <- function(d, xint, xlab, tag, log_scale = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(clean(d), aes(x = estimate, y = lab)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = xint, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high,
                        color = !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.05), size = 0.35) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("grey55", "black"), guide = "none") +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +   # keep rows so all 4 panels align
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL, tag = tag) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
  if (log_scale) p <- p + scale_x_log10()
  p
}

p1 <- panel(coefs_eq1, 0, "Effect on immediate loss (percentage points)", "A.")
p2 <- panel(coefs_eq2, 1, "Odds ratio (log scale)", "B.", log_scale = TRUE)
p3 <- panel(coefs_eq3, 0, "Ordered beta coefficient", "C.")
p4 <- panel(coefs_eq4, 1, "Time ratio (log scale)", "D.", log_scale = TRUE)

fig <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) 
fig[[1]] <- fig[[1]] + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))  # restore labels on A

fig
ggsave("Fig_model_coefficients.png", fig, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
get_coefs <- function(model, exponentiate = FALSE) {

}

coefs_eq1 <- get_coefs(m1_sc)

coefs_eq4 <- get_coefs(m_aft_int, exponentiate = TRUE)

veg <- c("CA Coastal Redwood", "CA Mesic Mixed Conifer",
         "CA Mixed Evergreen Hardwood", "CA Mixed Oak Woodland",
         "CA Montane Conifer", "Chaparral Shrubland",
         "Non-forest", "Other Forest", "Riparian")

label_map <- c(
  "dNBR_sc"          = "dNBR (1 SD)",
  "elevation_sc"     = "Elevation (1 SD)",
  "treecover_sc"     = "Tree cover (1 SD)",
  "def_pre_sc"       = "Pre-fire drought (1 SD)",
  "def_post_sc"      = "Post-fire drought (1 SD)",
  "slope_sc"         = "Slope (1 SD)",
  "sev_MT07Moderate" = "Moderate severity",
  "sev_MT07High"     = "High severity",
  "IFL_loss"         = "Immediate canopy loss (yr 1)"
)

term_lab <- function(x) {

}

shared_levels <- c("Moderate severity", "High severity",
                   veg,
                   "Immediate canopy loss (yr 1)",
                   "dNBR (1 SD)", "Elevation (1 SD)", "Tree cover (1 SD)",
                   "Pre-fire drought (1 SD)", "Post-fire drought (1 SD)",
                   "Slope (1 SD)")

clean <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)",
           !str_detect(term, ":"),
           term != "Log(scale)") %>%
    mutate(lab = term_lab(term)) %>%
    filter(lab %in% shared_levels) %>%
    mutate(lab = factor(lab, levels = shared_levels))
}

# UPDATED panel(): parallel "effect on ..." x labels, direction-colored points,
#   significance by shape, y labels only on left-column panels
panel <- function(d, xint, xlab, tag, sub, log_scale = FALSE, y_labels = TRUE) {
  d <- clean(d) %>%
    mutate(direction = ifelse(estimate > xint, "positive", "negative"),
           sig = ifelse(!is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.05, "significant", "n.s."))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = estimate, y = lab)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = xint, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high,
                        color = direction, shape = sig),
                    size = 0.35, stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(positive = "#B2182B", negative = "#2166AC"),
                       guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(significant = 16, `n.s.` = 1), guide = "none") +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL, tag = tag, subtitle = sub) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.tag       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle  = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0,
                                    margin = margin(b = 2)),
      axis.text.y    = element_text(size = 10,
                                    color = if (y_labels) "black" else "white")
    )
  if (log_scale) p <- p + scale_x_log10()
  p
}
```

```{r}
library(lme4)

  )

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A — Continuous predictors dumbbell
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tidy_int <- broom.mixed::tidy(
  m_int_full,
  effects      = "fixed",
  exponentiate = FALSE,
  conf.int     = TRUE,
  conf.level   = 0.95
)

cont_vars <- c("dNBR_sc", "elevation_sc", "treecover_sc",
               "def_post_sc", "slope_sc")

main_cont <- tidy_int %>%
  filter(term %in% cont_vars) %>%
  select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  rename(log_hi = estimate, ci_lo_hi = conf.low,
         ci_hi_hi = conf.high, p_main = p.value)

int_cont <- tidy_int %>%
  filter(
    grepl("^sev_binarylow_loss:", term),
    !grepl("EVT_GP_plot", term) 
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    term    = sub("sev_binarylow_loss:", "", term),
    log_int = estimate,
    se_int  = std.error,
    p_int   = p.value
  )

cont_df <- main_cont %>%
  left_join(int_cont, by = "term") %>%
  mutate(
    log_lo   = log_hi + log_int,
    OR_hi    = exp(log_hi),
    OR_lo    = exp(log_lo),
    OR_ci_lo = exp(ci_lo_hi),
    OR_ci_hi = exp(ci_hi_hi),
    sig_int  = ifelse(!is.na(p_int) & p_int < 0.05, "*", ""),
    label = factor(
      dplyr::recode(term,
        dNBR_sc      = "Burn intensity (dNBR)",
        elevation_sc = "Elevation",
        treecover_sc = "Pre-fire canopy cover",
        def_post_sc  = "Post-fire drought",
        slope_sc     = "Slope"
      ),
      levels = rev(dplyr::recode(
        cont_vars,
        dNBR_sc      = "Burn intensity (dNBR)",
        elevation_sc = "Elevation",
        treecover_sc = "Pre-fire canopy cover",
        def_post_sc  = "Post-fire drought",
        slope_sc     = "Slope"
      ))
    )
  )

cont_long <- cont_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(OR_hi, OR_lo),
    names_to  = "severity",
    values_to = "OR"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    severity = ifelse(severity == "OR_hi", "High loss", "Low loss"),
    ci_lo    = ifelse(severity == "High loss", OR_ci_lo, NA_real_),
    ci_hi    = ifelse(severity == "High loss", OR_ci_hi, NA_real_)
  )

fig_cont <- ggplot(
  cont_long,
  aes(y = label, x = OR, color = severity, shape = severity)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
             color = ref_col, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(group = label), color = "gray65",
            linewidth = 0.5, orientation = "y") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi),
                 height = 0.22, linewidth = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(
    data  = filter(cont_long, severity == "High loss"),
    aes(x = OR_ci_hi + 0.04, label = sig_int),
    hjust = 0, size = 5.0, color = "gray25", na.rm = TRUE,
    family = "Arial"
  ) +

      "Non-Forest"                  = "Non-Forest",
      "Other Forest"                = "Other Forest",
      .default = evt
    ),
    label = reorder(label, OR_hi)
  )

# Check the result

# PANELS C & D — Predicted probability curves
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

predict_prob <- function(model, focal_var, focal_seq,
                         sev_levels = c("high_loss", "low_loss")) {
  vcv <- as.matrix(vcov(model))
  cf  <- fixef(model)

  results <- lapply(sev_levels, function(sev) {
    is_low <- sev == "low_loss"
    preds  <- sapply(focal_seq, function(x) {
      lp <- cf["(Intercept)"]
      if (is_low) lp <- lp + cf["sev_binarylow_loss"]
      if (focal_var %in% names(cf)) lp <- lp + cf[focal_var] * x
      int_name <- paste0("sev_binarylow_loss:", focal_var)
      if (is_low && int_name %in% names(cf)) lp <- lp + cf[int_name] * x
      unname(lp)
    })
    ses <- sapply(focal_seq, function(x) {
      grad <- setNames(rep(0, length(cf)), names(cf))
      grad["(Intercept)"] <- 1
      if (is_low) grad["sev_binarylow_loss"] <- 1
      if (focal_var %in% names(grad)) grad[focal_var] <- x
      int_name <- paste0("sev_binarylow_loss:", focal_var)
      if (is_low && int_name %in% names(grad)) grad[int_name] <- x
      var_lp <- as.numeric(t(grad) %*% vcv %*% grad)
      sqrt(max(var_lp, 0))
    })
    data.frame(
      x        = focal_seq,
      severity = ifelse(is_low, "Low loss", "High loss"),
      prob     = plogis(preds),
      ci_lo    = plogis(preds - 1.96 * ses),
      ci_hi    = plogis(preds + 1.96 * ses)
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, results)
}
```

```{r}
  by = .(Correct_Plot_Label_final, EVT_GP_plot)
][, proportion := n / sum(n) * 100, by = Correct_Plot_Label_final]

evt_summary[, EVT_GP_plot := factor(EVT_GP_plot,
  levels = unique(evt_summary$EVT_GP_plot))]

# Elevation strata bar
p_elev <- ggplot(elev_summary,
                 aes(x = "", y = proportion, fill = elev_class)) +
  facet_wrap(~Correct_Plot_Label_final) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5,
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(proportion, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = elev_colors,
                    name = "Elevation strata") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Elevation", y = "Proportion (%)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
 
# EVT group bar
p_evt <- ggplot(evt_summary,
                aes(x = "", y = proportion, fill = EVT_GP_plot)) +
  facet_wrap(~Correct_Plot_Label_final) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5,
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(proportion > 3,
                               paste0(round(proportion, 1), "%"), "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 2.8, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evt_colors,
                    name = "Forest functional type") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Forest type", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
 
# Combine elevation and EVT side by side for Panel C
panel_C <- (p_elev | p_evt) +
  plot_annotation(title = "C",
                  theme = theme(
                    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
                  ))
p_elev <- p_elev + theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
p_evt  <- p_evt  + theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))

# ── ASSEMBLE FIGURE 1 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
figure_1 <- (panel_A | panel_B) / panel_C +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.45, 0.55)) +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = paste0(
      "Figure 1. "
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 5, hjust = 0,
                                  margin = margin(t = 5))
    )
  )

figure_1
# ── SAVE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
table(plot_metrics_analysis$class_4_new)

# ── Color palette (unchanged) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
class4_colors <- c(
  "Low loss- Immediate dominant"  = "#4DAF4A",
  "Low loss- Delayed dominant"    = "#377EB8",
  "High loss- Immediate dominant" = "#FF7F00",
  "High loss- Delayed dominant"   = "#E41A1C"
)

class4_summary <- plot_metrics_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(class_4_new)) %>%
  count(class_4_new, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

# print(class4_summary)
# table(plot_metrics_analysis$class_4_new)


# ── Annotation label positions (unchanged) ────────────────────────────────────
class4_positions <- class4_summary %>%
  mutate(
    x_pos = case_when(
      class_4_new == "Low loss- Immediate dominant"  ~ 20,
      class_4_new == "Low loss- Delayed dominant"    ~ 15,
      class_4_new == "High loss- Immediate dominant" ~ 65,
      class_4_new == "High loss- Delayed dominant"   ~ 20
    ),
    y_pos = case_when(
      class_4_new == "Low loss- Immediate dominant"  ~ 8,
      class_4_new == "Low loss- Delayed dominant"    ~ 25,
      class_4_new == "High loss- Immediate dominant" ~ 25,
      class_4_new == "High loss- Delayed dominant"   ~ 65
    )
  )

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_fig2 <- ggplot(
  plot_metrics_analysis %>% filter(!is.na(class_4_new)),
  aes(x = IFL_loss, y = PAL_loss, color = class_4_new)
) +

  # total loss = 50% boundary
  geom_abline(
    slope     = -1,
    intercept = 50,
    linetype  = "dashed",
    color     = "grey20",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
  "text",
  x = 52, y = 3,
  label = "Total Relative loss = 50%",
  size = 3.5,
  color = "grey20",
  fontface = "italic",
  hjust = 0
) +

  # 50% delayed proportion boundary (PAL = IFL diagonal)
  geom_abline(
    slope     = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype  = "dotted",
    color     = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
  "text",
  x = 55, y = 60,
  label = "50% delayed\nproportion",
  size = 3.5,
  color = "grey40",
  fontface = "italic",
  hjust = 0
) +

  # data points
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.20,
    size  = 0.65,
    shape = 16
  ) +

  # quadrant count labels
  geom_label(
    data = class4_positions,
    aes(
      x     = x_pos,
      y     = y_pos,
      label = paste0(class_4_new, "\nn = ", n, " (", pct, "%)"),
      color = class_4_new
    ),
    size        = 3.0,
    fontface    = "plain",
    fill        = "white",
    alpha       = 0.85,
    label.size  = 0.25,
    family      = "Arial",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = class4_colors, guide = "none") +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    labels = paste0(c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    labels = paste0(c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +

  labs(
    x       = "Immediate canopy loss (%)",
    y       = "Delayed canopy loss (%)",
    caption = paste0(
      "Dashed line: total relative canopy loss threshold (50%). ",
      "Dotted line: 50% delayed proportion boundary (delayed = immediate). ",
      "n = ",
      nrow(plot_metrics_final %>% filter(!is.na(class_4_new))),
      " burned plots."
    )
  ) +

  # ── Ecosphere theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    # axes
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),

    # caption replaces subtitle — cleaner for Ecosphere
    plot.caption     = element_text(
                         size    = 8,
                         color   = "grey40",
                         hjust   = 0,
                         margin  = margin(t = 4, unit = "pt")
                       ),

    # no gridlines on scatter
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),

    plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 4, "pt")
  )

# ── Preview ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_fig2

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

```{r}
            aes(x = delta_year, y = mean_cc, color = sev_MT07, group = sev_MT07),
            linewidth = 0.8) +

  # ── Stars at post-fire minimum ───────────────────────────────────────────
  geom_point(data = panelA_minimum,
             aes(x = delta_year, y = mean_cc, color = sev_MT07),
             shape = 8, size = 3, stroke = 1.1, show.legend = FALSE) +

  # ── IFL / PAL window annotations ─────────────────────────────────────────
  annotate("segment", x = 0.1, xend = 1.0, y = 65, yend = 42,
           arrow = arrow(ends = "last", length = unit(0.12, "cm")), color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 2.3, y = 48, label = "Immediate\nCanopy Loss",
           size = 3.3, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.8) +

  annotate("segment", x = 1.2, xend = 2.2, y = 42, yend = 21,
           arrow = arrow(ends = "last", length = unit(0.12, "cm")), color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 3.8, y = 30, label = "Delayed Canopy Loss",
           size = 3.3, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.8) +

  scale_color_manual(values = sev_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sev_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, by = 2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(10, 70, by = 5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(10, 70)) +
  labs(x = "Years since fire ignition", y = "Mean tree canopy cover (%)",
       subtitle = "Burned plots by severity vs. unburned control | Mean ± 95% CI | ★ = post-fire minimum") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
  axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
  axis.line  = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
  axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey4"),
  plot.margin   = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, "pt")
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B: Forest Type Trajectories FACETED by EVT with stars on burned lines
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

evts_ordered <- c(
  "CA Dry Mixed Conifer",
  "CA Mesic Mixed Conifer",
  "CA Montane Conifer",
  "CA Mixed Evergreen Hardwood",
  "CA Mixed Oak Woodland",
  "Non-forest",
  "Riparian",
  "Other Forest",
  "CA Coastal Redwood",
  "Chaparral Shrubland"
)

# Build data with both burned and unburned
tre_evt_all <- master %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    EVT_GP_plot %in% evts_ordered,
    delta_year >= -10,
    delta_year <= 10,
    !is.na(EVT_GP_plot)
  ) %>%
  # Separate burned and unburned for easier handling
  mutate(
    burn_status = case_when(
      Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean" ~ "Burned",
      Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Unburned_clean" ~ "Unburned",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(burn_status))

# Normalize burned plots to year 1 post-fire baseline
norm_baseline_evt <- tre_evt_all %>%
  filter(burn_status == "Burned", delta_year == 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(plot_key, TRE_yr1 = TRE)

tre_evt_all <- tre_evt_all %>%
  left_join(norm_baseline_evt, by = "plot_key") %>%
  mutate(
    TRE_norm = case_when(
      burn_status == "Burned" & !is.na(TRE_yr1) ~ TRE - TRE_yr1,
      burn_status == "Unburned" ~ TRE - mean(TRE[burn_status == "Unburned" & delta_year == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TRE_norm))

# Aggregate by forest type, severity, and year
tre_evt_summary <- tre_evt_all %>%
  group_by(EVT_GP_plot, delta_year, sev_MT07, burn_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_TRE = mean(TRE, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_TRE = sd(TRE, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    ci_upper = mean_TRE + 1.96 * se_TRE,
    ci_lower = mean_TRE - 1.96 * se_TRE,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 10)

# ── Find minimum points for BURNED plots only (per EVT × severity) ────────────
evt_sev_minimum <- tre_evt_summary %>%
  filter(burn_status == "Burned", delta_year >= 1) %>%  # Only burned, post-fire
  group_by(EVT_GP_plot, sev_MT07) %>%
  slice_min(mean_TRE, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Minimum canopy cover points per forest type × severity:\n")

# ── Factor ordering ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tre_evt_summary <- tre_evt_summary %>%
  mutate(
    EVT_GP_plot = factor(EVT_GP_plot, levels = evts_ordered),
    sev_MT07 = factor(sev_MT07, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
    burn_status = factor(burn_status, levels = c("Unburned", "Burned"))
  )

evt_sev_minimum <- evt_sev_minimum %>%
  mutate(
    EVT_GP_plot = factor(EVT_GP_plot, levels = evts_ordered),
    sev_MT07 = factor(sev_MT07, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"))
  )

# ── Define colors ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sev_colors <- c(

  "Low"      = "#4DAC26"
)

status_colors <- c("Burned" = "solid", "Unburned" = "twodash")

# ── Create faceted Panel B ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig2b <- ggplot(tre_evt_summary, 
                  aes(x = delta_year, y = mean_TRE, 
                      color = sev_MT07, fill = sev_MT07,
                      linetype = burn_status)) +
  
  # Confidence interval ribbons for burned only
  geom_ribbon(data = filter(tre_evt_summary, burn_status == "Burned"),
              aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  
  # Mean lines
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
  
  # ★ STARS at minimum points for BURNED plots only ★
  geom_point(data = evt_sev_minimum,
             aes(x = delta_year, y = mean_TRE, color = sev_MT07),
             shape = 8, size = 1.5, stroke = 1.1,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # Reference lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "twodash", color = "grey4", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey5", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  # Facet by forest type
  facet_wrap(~EVT_GP_plot, ncol = 3, scales = "fixed") +
  
  # Colors and linetypes
  scale_color_manual(
    values = sev_colors,
    name = "Burn Severity",
    breaks = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = sev_colors,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Burned" = "solid", "Unburned" = "twodash"),
    name = "Plot Type",
    labels = c("Burned" = "Burned", "Unburned" = "Unburned Control")
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "B. Forest Type Trajectories by Burn Severity",
    x = "Years Since Fire",
    y = "Mean Tree Canopy Cover (%)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(

    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(6, "pt")
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B: ABSOLUTE TREE CANOPY COVER
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Forest type ordering ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

evts_ordered <- c(
  "CA Dry Mixed Conifer",
  "CA Mesic Mixed Conifer",
  "CA Montane Conifer",
  "CA Mixed Evergreen Hardwood",
  "CA Mixed Oak Woodland",
  "Non-forest",
  "Riparian",
  "Other Forest",
  "CA Coastal Redwood",
  "Chaparral Shrubland"
)

sev_levels <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")

sev_colors <- c(
  "High"     = "#B2182B",
  "Moderate" = "#E08214",
  "Low"      = "#4DAC26"
)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BUILD PANEL B DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# IMPORTANT:
# TRE is used directly.
# No normalization to year 1.
# Therefore, mean_TRE = absolute mean canopy cover (%).

tre_evt_summary <- master %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    EVT_GP_plot %in% evts_ordered,
    delta_year >= -10,
    delta_year <= 10,
    !is.na(TRE),
    Correct_Plot_Label_final %in% c(
      "Burned_clean",
      "Unburned_clean"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    burn_status = case_when(
      Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean"   ~ "Burned",
      Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Unburned_clean" ~ "Unburned",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    EVT_GP_plot = factor(
      EVT_GP_plot,
      levels = evts_ordered
    ),

    sev_MT07 = factor(
      sev_MT07,
      levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(burn_status)) %>%
  group_by(
    EVT_GP_plot,
    delta_year,
    sev_MT07,
    burn_status
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),

    # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # ABSOLUTE CANOPY COVER
    # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    mean_TRE = mean(TRE, na.rm = TRUE),

    se_TRE = sd(TRE, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),

    ci_lower = mean_TRE - 1.96 * se_TRE,
    ci_upper = mean_TRE + 1.96 * se_TRE,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 10)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIND POST-FIRE MINIMUM FOR BURNED PLOTS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Minimum is based on ABSOLUTE canopy cover (mean_TRE).
# Only years >= 1 are considered.

evt_sev_minimum <- tre_evt_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    burn_status == "Burned",
    delta_year >= 1
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    EVT_GP_plot,
    sev_MT07
  ) %>%
  slice_min(
    order_by = mean_TRE,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAKE SURE FACTOR ORDERING IS CORRECT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tre_evt_summary <- tre_evt_summary %>%
  mutate(
    EVT_GP_plot = factor(
      EVT_GP_plot,
      levels = evts_ordered
    ),

    sev_MT07 = factor(
      sev_MT07,
      levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
    ),

    burn_status = factor(
      burn_status,
      levels = c("Unburned", "Burned")
    )
  )

evt_sev_minimum <- evt_sev_minimum %>%
  mutate(
    EVT_GP_plot = factor(
      EVT_GP_plot,
      levels = evts_ordered
    ),

    sev_MT07 = factor(
      sev_MT07,
      levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
    )
  )


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CHECK THE SUMMARY DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\nPanel B: Absolute canopy cover summary\n")
cat("--------------------------------------\n")

print(
  tre_evt_summary %>%
    select(
      EVT_GP_plot,
      delta_year,
      sev_MT07,
      burn_status,
      n,

      se_TRE,
      ci_lower,

    ) %>%
    arrange(
      EVT_GP_plot,
      delta_year,
      burn_status,
      sev_MT07
    )
)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B PLOT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fig2b <- ggplot(
  tre_evt_summary,
  aes(
    x = delta_year,
    y = mean_TRE,
    color = sev_MT07,
    fill = sev_MT07,
    linetype = burn_status,
    group = interaction(sev_MT07, burn_status)
  )
) +

  # ── Confidence intervals: BURNED ONLY ─────────────────────────────────────
  geom_ribbon(
    data = dplyr::filter(
      tre_evt_summary,
      burn_status == "Burned"
    ),
    aes(
      ymin = ci_lower,
      ymax = ci_upper,
      group = sev_MT07
    ),

  ) +

  # ── Mean trajectories ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.85
  ) +

  # ── Stars at post-fire minimum ────────────────────────────────────────────
  geom_point(
    data = evt_sev_minimum,
    aes(

      y = mean_TRE,
      color = sev_MT07
    ),
    shape = 8,
    size = 1.5,
    stroke = 1.1,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # ── Fire ignition ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "twodash",
    color = "grey4",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  # ── Year 1 reference ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "grey5",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  # ── Zero reference ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Kept here only as a visual reference; it is not a normalization baseline.
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "solid",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  # ── Facet by forest type ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  facet_wrap(
    ~EVT_GP_plot,
    ncol = 3,
    scales = "fixed"
  ) +

  # ── Severity colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  scale_color_manual(

    breaks = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = sev_colors,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  # ── Burned vs unburned line types ─────────────────────────────────────────
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "Burned" = "solid",
      "Unburned" = "twodash"
    ),
    name = "Plot Type",
    labels = c(
      "Burned" = "Burned",
      "Unburned" = "Unburned Control"
    )
  ) +

  # ── X axis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-10, 10, by = 2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +

  # ── Y axis: ABSOLUTE CANOPY COVER ─────────────────────────────────────────
  scale_y_continuous(

  labs(
    title = "B. Forest Type Trajectories by Burn Severity",

  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 8

    ),

    strip.text = element_text(

)

)
```

```{r}
# ── PANEL B: Absolute Canopy Cover by EVT and Severity ──────────────────────

    ci95_low  = mean_cc - 1.96 * se_cc,

  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 10)

# ── Unburned summary for Panel B (absolute values) ────────────────────────
unburned_panel_b <- master %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Unburned_clean",
    EVT_GP_plot %in% evts_ordered,
    delta_year >= -10,
    delta_year <= 10
  ) %>%
  mutate(EVT_GP_plot = factor(EVT_GP_plot, levels = evts_ordered)) %>%
  group_by(delta_year, EVT_GP_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    n         = n(),
    mean_cc   = mean(TRE, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_cc     = sd(TRE, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    ci95_low  = mean_cc - 1.96 * se_cc,
    ci95_high = mean_cc + 1.96 * se_cc,
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 10)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE PANEL A
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig4a <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  
  # Unburned control
  geom_ribbon(data = unburned_data,
              aes(x = delta_year, ymin = ci95_low, ymax = ci95_high),
              alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey50") +
  geom_line(data = unburned_data,
            aes(x = delta_year, y = mean_cc),
            linetype = "twodash", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  
  # Burned by severity
  geom_ribbon(data = panelA_data,
              aes(x = delta_year, y = mean_cc, ymin = ci95_low, ymax = ci95_high,
                  fill = sev_MT07, group = sev_MT07),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(data = panelA_data,
            aes(x = delta_year, y = mean_cc, color = sev_MT07, group = sev_MT07),
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Stars at post-fire minimum
  geom_point(data = panelA_minimum,
             aes(x = delta_year, y = mean_cc, color = sev_MT07),
             shape = 8, size = 3, stroke = 1.1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # Annotations for canopy loss windows
  annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = 1, y = 62, yend = 62,
           arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.12, "cm")), color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 64, label = "Immediate\nCanopy Loss",
           size = 2.3, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.8) +
  
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 10, y = 15, yend = 15,
           arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.12, "cm")), color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = 12, label = "Delayed Canopy Loss",
           size = 2.3, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.8) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = sev_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sev_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, by = 2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 70, by = 5), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(10, 70)) +
  
  labs(x = "Years since fire ignition", y = "Mean tree canopy cover (%)",
       subtitle = "Burned plots by severity vs. unburned control | Absolute values | Mean ± 95% CI") +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 8, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.line  = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey40"),
    plot.margin   = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, "pt")
  )

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE PANEL B: Absolute canopy cover by vegetation type
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig4b <- ggplot() +
  
  # Unburned control ribbon
  geom_ribbon(data = unburned_panel_b,
              aes(x = delta_year, ymin = ci95_low, ymax = ci95_high),
              fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.35, color = NA) +
  
  # Unburned control line
  geom_line(data = unburned_panel_b,
            aes(x = delta_year, y = mean_cc, linetype = "Unburned control"),
            color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Burned ribbons by severity
  geom_ribbon(data = panel_b_data,
              aes(x = delta_year, ymin = ci95_low, ymax = ci95_high,
                  fill = sev_MT07, group = sev_MT07),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  
  # Burned lines by severity
  geom_line(data = panel_b_data,
            aes(x = delta_year, y = mean_cc, color = sev_MT07, group = sev_MT07),
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ EVT_GP_plot, ncol = 3) +
  
  # Color and fill scales
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = "Burn Severity",
    values = sev_colors,
    breaks = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = sev_colors,
    guide  = "none"
  ) +
  
  # Linetype scale for unburned
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c("Unburned control" = "dotdash")
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2),
    limits = c(0, 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Years since fire",
    y = "Absolute tree canopy cover (%)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 8, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
    
    legend.position    = "top",
    legend.direction   = "horizontal",
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 7, face = "plain"),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size    = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    legend.key.width   = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.box         = "horizontal",
    legend.box.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
    legend.margin      = margin(0, 0, 2, 0),
    legend.spacing.x   = unit(4, "pt"),
    
    panel.spacing      = unit(4, "pt"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    
    plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, "pt")
  )

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COMBINE PANELS A & B
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig4b

fig4b_right <- fig4b +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.box       = "vertical"
  )

# ── Step 5: Combine with patchwork ───────────────────────────────────────────
fig4_combined <- (fig4a / fig4b_right) +

# add panel labels LAST

fig4a

fig4_combined
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

# ── COLORS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
evt_colors <- c(
  "CA Coastal Redwood"                     = "#277F8E",
  "CA Montane Conifer"                     = "#440154",
  "CA Dry Mixed Conifer"                   = "#1FA187",
  "CA Mesic Mixed Conifer"                 = "#46337E",
  "CA Mixed Evergreen Hardwood"            = "#4AC16D",
  "CA Mixed Oak Woodland"                  = "#365C8D",
  "Other Forest"                           = "#4D4D4D",
  "Non-forest"                             = "#E69F00",
  "Riparian"                               = "#D55E00",
  "Chaparral Shrubland"                    = "grey"
)

# ── TEXT COLOR FUNCTION ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_text_color <- function(hex_colors) {
  rgb_mat   <- col2rgb(hex_colors)
  luminance <- (0.299 * rgb_mat["red",   ] +
                0.587 * rgb_mat["green", ] +
                0.114 * rgb_mat["blue",  ]) / 255
  ifelse(luminance > 0.6, "black", "white")
}

# ── STEP 1: Compute proportions from master ───────────────────────────────────
evt_plot_data <- master[
  Correct_Plot_Label_final %chin% c("Burned_clean", "Unburned_clean") &
    !is.na(EVT_GP_plot),
  .(n = .N),
  by = .(Correct_Plot_Label_final, EVT_GP_plot)
][, proportion := n / sum(n) * 100, by = Correct_Plot_Label_final]

# ── STEP 2: Rank categories largest → smallest by BURNED proportion only ──────
# Using burned as reference so the same order applies to both facets,
# making it easy to visually compare a category's bar across facets
burned_rank <- evt_plot_data[
  Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean"
][order(-proportion), EVT_GP_plot]

# Any EVT present only in unburned (not burned) gets appended at the end
all_levels <- c(
  burned_rank,
  setdiff(unique(evt_plot_data$EVT_GP_plot), burned_rank)
)

# ── STEP 3: Apply factor, text color, label flag — ALL in one place ───────────
evt_plot_data[, EVT_GP_plot := factor(EVT_GP_plot, levels = all_levels)]
evt_plot_data[, text_col    := get_text_color(evt_colors)[as.character(EVT_GP_plot)]]
evt_plot_data[, show_label  := proportion > 5]

# ── STEP 4: Verify ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Proportion sums per facet (must be ~100):\n")
print(evt_plot_data[, .(total = sum(proportion)), by = Correct_Plot_Label_final])

cat("\nDuplicate colors (must be empty):\n")
print(evt_colors[duplicated(evt_colors) | duplicated(evt_colors, fromLast = TRUE)])

cat("\nEVT in data but missing from palette (must be empty):\n")
print(setdiff(unique(as.character(evt_plot_data$EVT_GP_plot)), names(evt_colors)))

# ── STEP 5: Build the plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Key principle: let ggplot handle ALL stacking internally via position_stack().
# The only thing we control is factor level order (which determines stack order)
# and the vjust = 0.5 midpoint label placement.
# This works reliably as long as the data fed to geom_bar and geom_text
# is IDENTICAL — same object, same factor, no separate labeled subset.

p_evt <- ggplot(
    evt_plot_data,
    aes(x     = Correct_Plot_Label_final,
        y     = proportion,
        fill  = EVT_GP_plot,
        label = ifelse(show_label, paste0(round(proportion, 1), "%"), ""),
        color = text_col)
  ) +
  geom_bar(
    stat     = "identity",
    position = position_stack(reverse = FALSE),
    width    = 0.55,
    color    = "black",      # bar border (overrides the color aes for the border only)
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    position  = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = FALSE),
    size      = 3.5,
    fontface  = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = evt_colors,
    breaks = all_levels,     # legend order matches stack order
    name   = "Forest functional type"
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +   # text_col values used directly as colors
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(0, 101)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Burned_clean" = "Burned", "Unburned_clean" = "Unburned")
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of plots (%)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 8.5),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y     = unit(0, "cm"),
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0, "cm"),
    legend.margin        = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.margin     = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, title.position = "top"))

p_evt

ggsave("evt_stacked_bar.png", p_evt,
       width = 7.5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
