```{r}
# ── REBUILD WITH SEVERITY LINES ───────────────────────────────────────────────
tre_evt_sev <- master %>%
  filter(Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean",
         delta_year >= -10 & delta_year <= 10,
         !is.na(sev_MT07),
         sev_MT07 %in% c("Low", "Moderate", "High")) %>%  # same guard
  group_by(delta_year, EVT_GP_plot, sev_MT07) %>%
  reframe(                                                 # replaces summarise
    mean_TRE = mean(TRE, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_TRE   = sd(TRE,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    ci_upper = mean_TRE + 1.96 * se_TRE,
    ci_lower = mean_TRE - 1.96 * se_TRE,
    n_plots  = n_distinct(plot_key)
  )

# Reorder Burn Severity:
tre_evt_sev <- tre_evt_sev %>%
  mutate(sev_MT07 = factor(sev_MT07, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")))

# Sample size label per EVT × severity
n_labels <- tre_evt_sev %>%
  distinct(EVT_GP_plot, sev_MT07, n_plots) %>%
  group_by(EVT_GP_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    label = paste0(
      "Low n=",      n_plots[sev_MT07=="Low"],      "\n",
      "Mod n=",      n_plots[sev_MT07=="Moderate"],  "\n",
      "High n=",     n_plots[sev_MT07=="High"]
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sev_colors <- c(
  "Low"      = "#009E73",
  "Moderate" = "#E69F00",
  "High"     = "#D55E00"
)

# ── MOVE LABELS TO BOTTOM-RIGHT, BELOW THE LINES ─────────────────────────────
# ── CORRECT n_labels — unique plots per EVT × severity ───────────────────────
n_labels <- master %>%
  filter(Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean",
         !is.na(sev_MT07),
         sev_MT07 != "",                          # drop empty strings
         sev_MT07 %in% c("Low","Moderate","High") # keep only valid levels
  ) %>%
  distinct(plot_key, EVT_GP_plot, sev_MT07) %>%
  group_by(EVT_GP_plot, sev_MT07) %>%
  summarise(n_plots = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = sev_MT07,
    values_from = n_plots,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  # guard against any severity column missing entirely
  mutate(
    Low      = if ("Low"      %in% names(.)) Low      else 0L,
    Moderate = if ("Moderate" %in% names(.)) Moderate else 0L,
    High     = if ("High"     %in% names(.)) High     else 0L,
    label    = paste0("L=", Low, "  M=", Moderate, "  H=", High)
  )

ggplot(tre_evt_sev,
       aes(x=delta_year, y=mean_TRE,
           color=sev_MT07, fill=sev_MT07)) +

  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=ci_lower, ymax=ci_upper),
              alpha=0.12, color=NA, show.legend=FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth=0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed",
             color="grey40", linewidth=0.5) +

  # Move label to bottom of each panel, single line
  geom_text(data       = n_labels,
            aes(x=-10, y=3, label=label),
            size        = 3.0,
            color       = "grey5",
            hjust       = 0,
            lineheight  = 1.0,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  facet_wrap(~ EVT_GP_plot, ncol=4) +

  scale_color_manual(values=sev_colors, name="Burn Severity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=sev_colors,  name="Burn Severity") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-10, 20, by=10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 100),
                     breaks=seq(0, 100, by=25)) +

  labs(
    title    = "Tree Canopy Cover by Forest Type and Burn Severity",
    subtitle = "Burned_clean plots only | Mean ± 95% CI",
    x        = "Years Since Fire Ignition",
    y        = "Mean Tree Canopy Cover (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=10) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color="grey40", size=7),
    strip.text       = element_text(face="bold", size=6.5,
                                    margin=margin(b=4)),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill="grey95", color=NA),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(face="bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1, "lines")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linewidth=2.5, alpha=1),
      nrow=1
    ),
    fill = "none"
  )
```

```{r}
# ── Step 3: Mortality class proportions per fire ─────────────

fire_class_props <- master %>%
  filter(Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean",
         class_4_new != "", !is.na(class_4_new)) %>%
  distinct(plot_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Fire_Name, class_4_new) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Fire_Name) %>%
  mutate(
    total_plots = sum(n),

    pct         = round(prop * 100, 1)
  ) %>%

  select(Fire_Name, class_4_new, prop, total_plots) %>%

    values_from = prop,
    values_fill = 0
```

fire centroids:
```{r}
# ── Step 4: Fire centroids ────────────────────────────────────

fire_centroids <- fires_study %>%
  group_by(Fire_Name) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%  # merge multi-part perimeters
  st_centroid() %>%
  mutate(
    lon = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
    lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Join centroids + class proportions + fire size for radius scaling
fire_class_wide <- fire_class_wide %>%
  left_join(fire_centroids, by = "Fire_Name") %>%
  left_join(
    fires_study %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      group_by(Fire_Name) %>%
      summarise(BurnBndAc = sum(BurnBndAc, na.rm = TRUE)),  # adjust col name
    by = "Fire_Name"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon)) %>%
  mutate(radius = scales::rescale(sqrt(BurnBndAc), to = c(0.08, 0.45)))

# Check column names for class_4 values
names(fire_class_wide)
```

```{r}
make_fire_pie <- function(fire_name) {
  dat <- master %>%
    filter(Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean",
           Fire_Name == fire_name,
           class_4_new != "", !is.na(class_4_new)) %>%
    distinct(plot_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    count(class_4_new) %>%
    mutate(
      pct   = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
      label = ifelse(pct >= 10, paste0(pct, "%"), "")
    )

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = "", y = pct, fill = class_4_new)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1,
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
              size = 2.5, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors) +
    labs(title = stringr::str_to_title(fire_name)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold",
                                     size  = 7.5,
                                     margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 2))  # ← explicit namespace
    )
}
```

sev_MT07
Pie slices = categorical burn severity (sev_MT07)

Slice size = number/proportion of plots in each severity

Slice fill = continuous prop_delayed (proportion of delayed mortality)
```{r}
# ── Step 4: Inset pie chart function ─────────────────────────
make_fire_pie <- function(fire_name) {

  dat <- master %>%
    filter(
      Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean",
      Fire_Name == fire_name,
      !is.na(sev_MT07),
      !is.na(prop_delayed)
    ) %>%
    distinct(plot_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(sev_MT07) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      prop_delayed = mean(prop_delayed, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = n / sum(n) * 100,
      label = ifelse(
        pct >= 10,
        paste0(round(pct, 1), "%"),
        ""
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(x = "", y = n, fill = prop_delayed)
  ) +
    geom_bar(
      stat = "identity",
      width = 1,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 2.5,
      color = "black",
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "plasma",
      name = "Delayed mortality",
      labels = scales::percent
    ) +
    labs(
      title = stringr::str_to_title(fire_name)
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 7.5,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 2)
      )
    )
}
```

# Instead of pie charts look at the actual burned plots in the fire perimeters colored by mortality severity class
Here is the additional R code to build the individual fire insets and combine everything:
```{r}
library(grid)

class_colors <- c(
  "Low loss- Immediate dominant"  = "#2C7BB6",
  "Low loss- Delayed dominant"    = "#7B2D8B",
  "High loss- Immediate dominant" = "#FDAE61",
  "High loss- Delayed dominant"   = "#8B0000"
)

# ── Step 0: Convert master plots to sf ───────────────────────
# Check what coordinate columns are named in your master dataframe
names(master)[grep("lon|lat|x|y|coord|centroid", 
                   names(master), ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Adjust column names below to match your actual coordinate columns
plots_sf <- master %>%
  filter(Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean",
         class_4_new != "", !is.na(class_4_new)) %>%
  distinct(plot_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(long), !is.na(lat)) %>%   # ← replace lon/lat if named differently
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"),     # ← replace lon/lat if named differently
           crs = 4326)

# ── Corrected inset function ──────────────────────────────────
make_fire_inset <- function(fire_name, plots_sf, fires_highlight_sf,
                             class_colors, padding = 0.08) {

  fire_perim <- fires_highlight_sf %>%
    filter(Fire_Name == fire_name) %>%
    st_transform(crs = 4326)

  fire_plots <- plots_sf %>%
    filter(Fire_Name == fire_name) %>%
    st_transform(crs = 4326)

  bbox  <- st_bbox(fire_perim)
  x_pad <- (bbox["xmax"] - bbox["xmin"]) * padding
  y_pad <- (bbox["ymax"] - bbox["ymin"]) * padding

  display_name <- dplyr::case_when(
    #fire_name == "YOLLA BOLLY COMPLEX (IRON)" ~ "Yolla Bolly\nComplex (Iron)",
    #fire_name == "BASIN COMPLEX"              ~ "Basin Complex",
    TRUE ~ stringr::str_to_title(fire_name)
  )

  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = fire_perim,
            fill = "grey92", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_sf(data = fire_plots,
            aes(color = class_4_new),
            size = 1.0, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = class_colors, guide = "none") +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(bbox["xmin"] - x_pad, bbox["xmax"] + x_pad),
      ylim = c(bbox["ymin"] - y_pad, bbox["ymax"] + y_pad)
    ) +
    ggtitle(display_name) +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title  = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "pt")
    )
}

# ── Generate 5 insets ─────────────────────────────────────────
insets <- lapply(highlight_fires, function(fn) {
  make_fire_inset(fn, plots_sf, fires_highlight_sf, class_colors)
})
names(insets) <- highlight_fires

# Quick check one renders correctly before assembling
print(insets[["WOLF CREEK"]])

# ── Assemble final figure ─────────────────────────────────────
# 2-column grid of insets (adjust ncol to taste)
# ── Generate 4 insets (margin applied inside function already) ─
inset_grid <- patchwork::wrap_plots(insets, ncol = 2)

# ── Assemble final figure ──────────────────────────────────────
final_figure <- p_main + inset_grid +
  patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1.2)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"))
  )

print(final_figure)

ggsave("Fig_CA_mortality_insets.png", final_figure,
       width = 9, height = 9, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

For each fire × class_4_new, use all plots belonging to that mortality class, calculate the contribution of each sev_MT07 category to prop_delayed, and display that as a three-slice pie.
```{r}
pie_data <- master %>%
  filter(
    Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean",
    Fire_Name %in% highlight_fires,
    !is.na(class_4_new),
    class_4_new != "",
    !is.na(sev_MT07),
    !is.na(total_loss_rel) # prop_delayed
  ) %>%
  distinct(plot_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    sev_MT07 = factor(
      sev_MT07,
      levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Fire_Name,
    class_4_new,
    sev_MT07
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_loss_rel = sum(total_loss_rel, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Fire_Name, class_4_new) %>%
  mutate(
    total_loss_pct =
      total_loss_rel / sum(total_loss_rel) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


sev_colors <- c("Low"="#009E73", "Moderate"="#E69F00", "High"="#0072B2")

```

```{r}
make_mortality_pie <- function(fire_name, mortality_class) {

  dat <- pie_data %>%
    filter(
      Fire_Name == fire_name,
      class_4_new == mortality_class
    )

  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        ggtitle("No data")
    )
  }

  ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(
      x = "",
      y = total_loss_pct, #prop_delayed_pct
       fill = sev_MT07
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 1,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = ifelse(
          total_loss_pct >= 10,
          paste0(round(total_loss_pct), "%"),
          ""
        )
      ),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 2.5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_polar("y") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = sev_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "pt")
    )
}

class_colors <- c(

  "Low loss- Delayed dominant"    = "#7B2D8B",
  "High loss- Immediate dominant" = "darkorange",
  "High loss- Delayed dominant"   = "#8B0000"
)
```

Try the following: prep for Fig S7
Figure concept: 4 rows × 3 columns = 12 panels. Each row represents one mortality class. Each panel shows one representative fire: plot points colored by mortality class inside the fire perimeter, with a small inset pie chart showing that fire's class proportions.
```{r}
# ── Step 1: Identify dominant class and select 3 fires per class ─

fire_dominant <- master %>%
  filter(Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean",
         class_4_new != "", !is.na(class_4_new)) %>%
  distinct(plot_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Fire_Name, class_4_new) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Fire_Name) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), prop = n / total) %>%
  ungroup()

# Fire-level dominant class (highest proportion class wins)
fire_dominant_class <- fire_dominant %>%
  group_by(Fire_Name) %>%
  slice_max(prop, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(dominant_class = class_4_new, dominant_prop = prop) %>%
  filter(total >= 20)  # minimum plot threshold for reliability

# Select top 3 fires per dominant class by proportion
# Option A — purely by dominance strength (highest proportion)
selected_fires <- fire_dominant_class %>%
  group_by(dominant_class) %>%
  slice_max(dominant_prop, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Option B — if you want geographic spread, manually override here:
# selected_fires <- fire_dominant_class %>%
#   filter(Fire_Name %in% c("FIRE_A", "FIRE_B", ...))

selected_fire_names <- selected_fires$Fire_Name
cat("Selected fires:\n")
print(selected_fires %>% select(Fire_Name, dominant_class, dominant_prop, total))
```

```{r}
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE,
              linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = class4_colors,
    name   = "Mortality class",
    guide  = guide_legend(ncol = 1)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2000:2014) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = paste0(seq(0, 100, 25), "%"),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    limits = c(0, 105)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Proportion of High Burn Severity Plots by Mortality Class and Fire Year",
    subtitle = "Dashed lines = LOESS trend | High severity = dNBR ≥ 367 (Miller & Thode 2007)",
    x        = "Fire ignition year",
    y        = "% High Burn severity plots"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  )

p_line
```

# For Figure S8
```{r}
# ── Step 2: Build per-fire map + pie inset panels ─────────────
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

make_fire_panel <- function(fire_name, plots_sf, fires_sf,
                             fire_dominant, class_colors,
                             dominant_class_label,
                             padding = 0.08) {

  # Fire perimeter
  fire_perim <- fires_sf %>%
    filter(Fire_Name == fire_name) %>%
    group_by(Fire_Name) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    st_transform(crs = 4326)

  # Plot points
  fire_plots <- plots_sf %>%
    filter(Fire_Name == fire_name) %>%
    st_transform(crs = 4326)

  bbox  <- st_bbox(fire_perim)
  x_pad <- (bbox["xmax"] - bbox["xmin"]) * padding
  y_pad <- (bbox["ymax"] - bbox["ymin"]) * padding

  # ── Map ──
  p_map <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = fire_perim,
            fill = "grey93", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_sf(data = fire_plots,
            aes(color = class_4_new),
            size = 1.2, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_color_manual(values = class_colors, guide = "none") +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(bbox["xmin"] - x_pad, bbox["xmax"] + x_pad),
      ylim = c(bbox["ymin"] - y_pad, bbox["ymax"] + y_pad)
    ) +
    ggtitle(stringr::str_to_title(fire_name)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      plot.title  = element_text(size = 6.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "pt")
    )

  # ── Pie inset ──
  pie_dat <- fire_dominant %>%
    filter(Fire_Name == fire_name) %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(prop >= 0.10, paste0(round(prop * 100), "%"), ""))

  p_pie <- ggplot(pie_dat, aes(x = "", y = prop, fill = class_4_new)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1,
             color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
              size = 1.6, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors, guide = "none") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt"))

  # ── Combine map + pie with cowplot ──
  ggdraw(p_map) +
    draw_plot(p_pie,
              x = 0.65, y = 0.01,   # bottom-right corner
              width = 0.33, height = 0.33)
}
```

Generate the perimeters and their paired pie charts:

#Fig. S8 with topogrphy gradient added
Better alternative if topography context is important: Add a single elevation-scaled background color (low = light, high = dark) rather than full hillshade. This is subtle, adds elevation context, and does not compete with point colors:
```{r}
library(elevatr)
library(terra)

add_elevation_background <- function(fire_perim) {
  
  # Get elevation raster clipped to fire bbox
  elev <- elevatr::get_elev_raster(
    locations = fire_perim,
    z         = 10,          # zoom level — increase for smaller fires
    clip      = "locations"
  )
  
  # Convert to dataframe for geom_raster
  elev_df <- as.data.frame(elev, xy = TRUE) %>%
    setNames(c("x", "y", "elevation")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(elevation))
  
  # Add to map as subtle grey gradient
  geom_raster(data = elev_df,
              aes(x = x, y = y, fill = elevation),
              alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "grey60",
                        guide = "none")
}

```

```{r}
library(elevatr)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)

# ── Step 1: Pre-download elevation for all selected fires ──────
# Do this once outside the panel function to avoid 12 separate downloads

get_fire_elevation <- function(fire_name, fires_sf, z = 10) {
  
  fire_perim <- fires_sf %>%
    filter(Fire_Name == fire_name) %>%
    group_by(Fire_Name) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    st_transform(crs = 4326)
  
  # Download elevation clipped to fire perimeter bounding box
  elev <- elevatr::get_elev_raster(
    locations = fire_perim,
    z         = z,          
    clip      = "bbox"      # clip to bounding box, not perimeter shape
  )
  
  # Convert to dataframe for geom_raster
  elev_df <- as.data.frame(elev, xy = TRUE) %>%
    setNames(c("x", "y", "elevation")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(elevation))
  
  return(elev_df)
}

# Download for all 12 selected fires — this may take 1-2 minutes
# z = 10 is good for medium fires; increase to 11-12 for small fires
cat("Downloading elevation data for", length(ordered_names), "fires...\n")

elevation_cache <- lapply(ordered_names, function(fn) {
  cat("  Fetching:", fn, "\n")
  tryCatch(
    get_fire_elevation(fn, fires_sf, z = 10),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  WARNING: elevation failed for", fn, "—", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)   # returns NULL if download fails; map still renders
    }
  )
})
names(elevation_cache) <- ordered_names
```

```{r}
# ── Step 2: Updated make_fire_panel with elevation layer ───────

make_fire_panel <- function(fire_name, plots_sf, fires_sf,
                             fire_dominant, class_colors,
                             elev_df = NULL,       # pass pre-cached elevation
                             padding = 0.08) {

  fire_perim <- fires_sf %>%
    filter(Fire_Name == fire_name) %>%
    group_by(Fire_Name) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    st_transform(crs = 4326)

  fire_plots <- plots_sf %>%
    filter(Fire_Name == fire_name) %>%
    st_transform(crs = 4326)

  bbox  <- st_bbox(fire_perim)
  x_pad <- (bbox["xmax"] - bbox["xmin"]) * padding
  y_pad <- (bbox["ymax"] - bbox["ymin"]) * padding

  # ── Base map — start with elevation if available ──────────────
  p_map <- ggplot()

  if (!is.null(elev_df)) {
    p_map <- p_map +
      geom_raster(data = elev_df,
                  aes(x = x, y = y, fill = elevation),
                  alpha = 0.45) +                      # subtle — adjust 0.3-0.6
      scale_fill_gradient(
        low   = "white",
        high  = "grey50",
        guide = "none"
      )
  }

  # ── Add fire perimeter, plot points ───────────────────────────
  p_map <- p_map +
    geom_sf(data = fire_perim,
            fill  = if (is.null(elev_df)) "grey93" else NA,  # transparent if elev shown
            color = "grey30",
            linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_sf(data = fire_plots,
            aes(color = class_4_new),
            size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_color_manual(values = class_colors, guide = "none") +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(bbox["xmin"] - x_pad, bbox["xmax"] + x_pad),
      ylim = c(bbox["ymin"] - y_pad, bbox["ymax"] + y_pad)
    ) +
    ggtitle(stringr::str_to_title(fire_name)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title  = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "pt")
    )

  # ── Pie chart ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pie_dat <- fire_dominant %>%
    filter(Fire_Name == fire_name) %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(prop >= 0.08,
                          paste0(round(prop * 100), "%"), ""))

  p_pie <- ggplot(pie_dat, aes(x = "", y = prop, fill = class_4_new)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1,
             color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
              size      = 3.5,
              color     = "white",
              fontface  = "bold") +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors, guide = "none") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "pt"))

  # ── Side-by-side map + pie ────────────────────────────────────
  p_map + p_pie +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(2.5, 1))
}
```
```{r}
# ── Step 3: Generate panels passing cached elevation ───────────

panels <- lapply(ordered_names, function(fn) {
  make_fire_panel(
    fire_name    = fn,
    plots_sf     = plots_sf,
    fires_sf     = fires_sf,
    fire_dominant = fire_dominant,
    class_colors  = class_colors,

  )
})
names(panels) <- ordered_names
```

```{r}
# Panel A — dNBR histogram with threshold lines
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Burn Severity Comparison Figures
# Requires: sev_MT07, sev_RdNBR, dNBR_yr1, sev_class already in master
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Working dataset: one row per burned plot (deduplicated on plot_key) ───────
bc <- master[
  !is.na(dNBR_yr1) &
  Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean" &
  !duplicated(plot_key)
]

cat("Plots in bc:", nrow(bc), "\n")

sev_levels <- c("Low", "Moderate", "High")

# Confirm factor levels are set (safe to re-run)
bc[, sev_MT07  := factor(sev_MT07,  levels = c("Unburned/Regrowth", sev_levels))]
bc[, sev_RdNBR := factor(sev_RdNBR, levels = c("Unburned/Regrowth", sev_levels))]
bc[, sev_class := factor(sev_class,  levels = sev_levels)]

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A — dNBR histogram with Miller & Thode (2007) threshold lines
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

pA <- ggplot(bc[dNBR_yr1 >= -200], aes(x = dNBR_yr1)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 20, fill = "#5B8DB8", colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 41,  linetype = "dashed", colour = "#2CA02C", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 176, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#FF7F0E", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 367, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#D62728", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 108,  y = Inf, label = "Low\n41–175",
           vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2, colour = "#2CA02C") +
  annotate("text", x = 271,  y = Inf, label = "Moderate\n176–366",
           vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2, colour = "#FF7F0E") +
  annotate("text", x = 550,  y = Inf, label = "High\n≥367",
           vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2, colour = "#D62728") +
  labs(
    title = "A. dNBR Distribution with Miller & Thode (2007) Thresholds",
    x     = "dNBR (1-year post-fire)",
    y     = "Number of plots"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B — Agreement heat-map: MT07 dNBR vs MTBS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ct <- as.data.table(
  table(
    MT07_dNBR = bc[sev_MT07 %in% sev_levels, sev_MT07],
    MTBS      = bc[sev_MT07 %in% sev_levels, sev_class],
    useNA     = "no"
  )
)
ct[, pct := round(100 * N / sum(N), 1)]
ct[, MT07_dNBR := factor(MT07_dNBR, levels = rev(sev_levels))]  # reverse for top-to-bottom

pB <- ggplot(ct, aes(x = MTBS, y = MT07_dNBR, fill = pct)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(N, "\n(", pct, "%)")), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#EBF5FB", high = "#1A5276", name = "% plots") +
  labs(
    title = "B. Agreement: MT07 dNBR vs MTBS Severity Class",
    x     = "MTBS Class",
    y     = "MT07 dNBR Class"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C — Mean immediate canopy loss by severity class, all three methods
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Reshape to long format — one row per plot × method
long_sev <- rbind(
  bc[sev_MT07  %in% sev_levels, .(IFL, SevClass = as.character(sev_MT07),  Method = "MT07 dNBR")],
  bc[sev_RdNBR %in% sev_levels, .(IFL, SevClass = as.character(sev_RdNBR), Method = "MT07 RdNBR")],
  bc[!is.na(sev_class),         .(IFL, SevClass = as.character(sev_class),  Method = "MTBS")]
)
long_sev[, SevClass := factor(SevClass, levels = sev_levels)]

summ_C <- long_sev[, .(
  mean_IFL = mean(IFL, na.rm = TRUE),
  se_IFL   = sd(IFL,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N),
  n        = .N
), by = .(Method, SevClass)]

pC <- ggplot(summ_C, aes(x = SevClass, y = mean_IFL,
                          colour = Method, group = Method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_IFL - se_IFL,
                    ymax = mean_IFL + se_IFL), width = 0.15) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("MT07 dNBR"  = "#D62728",
               "MT07 RdNBR" = "#FF7F0E",
               "MTBS"       = "#1F77B4")
  ) +
  labs(
    title  = "C. Mean Immediate Canopy Loss by Severity Class",
    x      = "Severity Class",
    y      = "Mean Immediate Canopy Loss (%)",
    colour = "Classification Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COMBINE AND SAVE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fig_combined <- pA / (pB | pC) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Burn Severity Classification Comparison",
    subtitle = "Miller & Thode (2007) dNBR thresholds vs MTBS vs RdNBR — Burned Clean plots (n = 12,706)",
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  )

fig_combined
ggsave("burn_severity_comparison.png", fig_combined,
       width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("Figure saved: burn_severity_comparison.png\n")

# ── Quick numeric summary to accompany the figure ────────────────────────────
cat("\n── MT07 dNBR class counts ──\n")
print(bc[, .N, by = sev_MT07][order(sev_MT07)])

cat("\n── MT07 RdNBR class counts ──\n")
print(bc[!is.na(sev_RdNBR), .N, by = sev_RdNBR][order(sev_RdNBR)])

cat("\n── Mean IFL by MT07 dNBR class ──\n")

         .(mean_IFL = round(mean(IFL, na.rm=TRUE), 1),
           sd_IFL   = round(sd(IFL,   na.rm=TRUE), 1),
           n        = .N),
         by = sev_MT07][order(sev_MT07)])
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1: Build ONE canonical, corrected plot-level EVT lookup from master

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3: Rebuild EVT_GP_collapsed (used in M3 AFT model) — <100 plot threshold
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
evt_tab <- table(plot_metrics_analysis$EVT_GP_plot)
rare_levels <- names(evt_tab[evt_tab < 100])
cat("\nLevels collapsed to 'Other' (n<100):", paste(rare_levels, collapse=", "), "\n")

plot_metrics_analysis$EVT_GP_collapsed[

] <- "Other"

  ref = "CA Jeffrey/Ponderosa Pine"
)
print(table(plot_metrics_analysis$EVT_GP_collapsed))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4: Rebuild dt3 and EVT_clean (used in M4) from the CORRECTED EVT_GP_plot
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# dt3 was derived from plot_metrics_analysis with manual grouping + rare-type
# drops — rebuild both from scratch using the corrected classification

dt <- copy(plot_metrics_analysis)

dt[, EVT_clean := EVT_GP_plot]
dt[EVT_clean %in% c(
  "CA Dry-Mesic Mixed Conifer", "CA Mesic Mixed Conifer",
  "CA Montane Conifer", "CA Red Fir Forest"
), EVT_clean := "Conifer"]
dt[EVT_clean %in% c(
  "CA Jeffrey/Ponderosa Pine", "CA Mixed Evergreen", "CA Mixed Oak Woodland"
), EVT_clean := "Mixed Forest"]
dt[EVT_clean == "CA Coastal Redwood", EVT_clean := "Redwood"]
dt[EVT_clean == "Riparian", EVT_clean := "Riparian"]
dt[EVT_clean == "Other Forest (unclassified)", EVT_clean := "Other Forest"]
dt[EVT_clean %in% c(
  "Other Riparian Forest (non-CA subtype)",
  "Other Mixed Forest/Woodland",
  "Non-Forest",
  "Serpentine Systems"
), EVT_clean := "Rare/Other"]

dt[!EVT_clean %in% c("Conifer","Mixed Forest","Redwood","Riparian", "Other Forest","Rare/Other"),
   .N, by=EVT_clean]  # <- check this output before proceeding

drop_types <- c(
  "Other Conifer Forest (non-CA subtype)"  # now genuinely n=2 after corrections
)
dt3 <- dt[!EVT_GP_plot %in% drop_types]
dt3[, EVT_clean := relevel(factor(EVT_clean), ref = "Conifer")]

cat("\ndt3 EVT_clean distribution:\n")
print(table(dt3$EVT_clean))

# ── Rebuild sev_binary and delayed_dom (unchanged logic, just on corrected dt3) ──
dt3[, sev_binary := fcase(
  class_4_clean %chin% c("high_delayed", "high_immediate"), "high_severity",
  class_4_clean %chin% c("low_delayed", "low_immediate"),  "low_severity",
  default = NA_character_
)]
dt3[, delayed_dom := as.integer(class_4_clean %chin% c("high_delayed", "low_delayed"))]
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Propagate corrected EVT_GP_plot to dd_model_data and dd_model_data_full (M5)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

dd_model_data <- dd_model_data %>%
  select(-any_of("EVT_GP_plot")) %>%
  left_join(evt_corrected, by = "plot_key")

cat("dd_model_data unmatched:", sum(is.na(dd_model_data$EVT_GP_plot)), "\n")

# Rebuild EVT_broad from corrected EVT_GP_plot (same groupings as before,
# but now needs to account for Riparian/Non-Forest, which weren't
# explicit categories when this grouping was first written)
dd_model_data[, EVT_broad := fcase(
  EVT_GP_plot %in% c(
    "CA Mixed Oak Woodland", "CA Mixed Evergreen",
    "CA Jeffrey/Ponderosa Pine", "CA Dry-Mesic Mixed Conifer"
  ), "warm_dry_forest",

  EVT_GP_plot %in% c("CA Mesic Mixed Conifer", "CA Coastal Redwood"),
  "mesic_conifer",

  EVT_GP_plot %in% c("CA Red Fir Forest", "CA Montane Conifer"),
  "cold_high_elevation",

  EVT_GP_plot %in% c(
    "Other Hardwood Forest (non-CA subtype)",
    "Other Mixed Forest/Woodland"
  ), "hardwood_mixed",

  EVT_GP_plot %in% c(
    "Riparian", "Riparian Forest (non-CA subtype)", "Serpentine Systems",
    "Non-Forest", "Other Conifer Forest (non-CA subtype)",
    "Other Forest (unclassified)"
  ), "special_other",

  default = "special_other"
)]

cat("dd_model_data EVT_broad distribution:\n")
print(table(dd_model_data$EVT_broad))

# Repeat identically for dd_model_data_full
dd_model_data_full <- dd_model_data_full %>%
  select(-any_of("EVT_GP_plot")) %>%
  left_join(evt_corrected, by = "plot_key")

cat("\ndd_model_data_full unmatched:", sum(is.na(dd_model_data_full$EVT_GP_plot)), "\n")

dd_model_data_full[, EVT_broad := fcase(
  EVT_GP_plot %in% c(
    "CA Mixed Oak Woodland", "CA Mixed Evergreen",
    "CA Jeffrey/Ponderosa Pine", "CA Dry-Mesic Mixed Conifer"
  ), "warm_dry_forest",
  EVT_GP_plot %in% c("CA Mesic Mixed Conifer", "CA Coastal Redwood"),
  "mesic_conifer",
  EVT_GP_plot %in% c("CA Red Fir Forest", "CA Montane Conifer"),
  "cold_high_elevation",
  EVT_GP_plot %in% c(
    "Other Hardwood Forest (non-CA subtype)", "Other Mixed Forest/Woodland"
  ), "hardwood_mixed",
  EVT_GP_plot %in% c(
    "Riparian", "Riparian Forest (non-CA subtype)", "Serpentine Systems",
    "Non-Forest", "Other Conifer Forest (non-CA subtype)",

  ), "special_other",
  default = "special_other"
)]

print(table(dd_model_data_full$EVT_broad))
```

```{r}
)]

# Identify which EVT_GP_plot value(s) are falling into UNEXPECTED_VALUE

# And get counts, in case more than one category is involved
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SELECT 2-3 FIRES REPRESENTING DIFFERENT MORTALITY PATTERNS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# From your mortality class distributions:
# - Broder Wu: 94% immediate dominant (uniform pattern expected)
# - Summit: 64% immediate, 35% delayed (mixed pattern)
# - Canoe: 58% immediate, 40% delayed (delayed-heavy)

representative_fires_spatial <- c("Broder Wu", "Summit", "Canoe")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE 3-FIRE × 4-PANEL SPATIAL VISUALIZATION
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

create_fire_spatial_mortality <- function(fire_to_map, data) {
  
  # Extract fire data
  fire_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Fire_Name == fire_to_map,
      !is.na(long), !is.na(lat),
      !is.na(dNBR), !is.na(IFL_loss), !is.na(PAL_loss)
    ) %>%
    distinct(plot_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      prop_delayed_pct = (PAL_loss / (IFL_loss + PAL_loss)) * 100
    )
  
  if(nrow(fire_data) == 0) {
    cat("WARNING: No data for", fire_to_map, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  n_plots <- nrow(fire_data)
  
  # Summary stats
  mean_immediate <- mean(fire_data$IFL_loss, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_delayed <- mean(fire_data$PAL_loss, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_prop_delayed <- mean(fire_data$prop_delayed_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_dNBR <- mean(fire_data$dNBR, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("\n%s (n=%d)\n", fire_to_map, n_plots))
  cat(sprintf("  Mean Immediate: %.1f%% | Mean Delayed: %.1f%% | Prop Delayed: %.1f%%\n",
              mean_immediate, mean_delayed, mean_prop_delayed))
  
  # Fire perimeter
  buffer <- 0.08
  xlim <- c(min(fire_data$long, na.rm=T) - buffer, max(fire_data$long, na.rm=T) + buffer)
  ylim <- c(min(fire_data$lat, na.rm=T) - buffer, max(fire_data$lat, na.rm=T) + buffer)
  
  # Create fire perimeter
  hull_indices <- chull(fire_data$long, fire_data$lat)
  fire_perimeter <- fire_data[hull_indices, ]
  fire_perimeter <- rbind(fire_perimeter, fire_perimeter[1, ])
  
  # ── Panel A: dNBR (Burn Severity) ─────────────────────────────────────────
  p1 <- ggplot(fire_data, aes(x = long, y = lat, color = dNBR, fill = dNBR)) +
    geom_polygon(data = fire_perimeter, aes(x = long, y = lat),
                 fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75, shape = 21, stroke = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#FFFFCC", high = "#8B0000",
      name = "dNBR",
      limits = c(0, 600)
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient(
      low = "#FFFFCC", high = "#8B0000",
      guide = "none",
      limits = c(0, 600)
    ) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, ratio = 1) +
    labs(title = "A. Burn Severity (dNBR)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F5F5", color = NA)
    )
  
  # ── Panel B: Immediate Mortality Loss ─────────────────────────────────────
  p2 <- ggplot(fire_data, aes(x = long, y = lat, color = IFL_loss, fill = IFL_loss)) +
    geom_polygon(data = fire_perimeter, aes(x = long, y = lat),
                 fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75, shape = 21, stroke = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#FFFFEB", high = "#FFA500",
      name = "Immediate Loss (%)",
      limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient(
      low = "#FFFFEB", high = "#FFA500",
      guide = "none",
      limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, ratio = 1) +
    labs(title = "B. Immediate Canopy Loss", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F5F5", color = NA)
    )
  
  # ── Panel C: Delayed Mortality Loss ──────────────────────────────────────
  p3 <- ggplot(fire_data, aes(x = long, y = lat, color = PAL_loss, fill = PAL_loss)) +
    geom_polygon(data = fire_perimeter, aes(x = long, y = lat),
                 fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75, shape = 21, stroke = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#F7F7F7", high = "#8B0000",
      name = "Delayed Loss (%)",
      limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient(
      low = "#F7F7F7", high = "#8B0000",
      guide = "none",
      limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, ratio = 1) +
    labs(title = "C. Delayed Canopy Loss", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F5F5", color = NA)
    )
  
  # ── Panel D: Proportion Delayed Mortality ───────────────────────────────
  p4 <- ggplot(fire_data, aes(x = long, y = lat, color = prop_delayed_pct, fill = prop_delayed_pct)) +
    geom_polygon(data = fire_perimeter, aes(x = long, y = lat),
                 fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75, shape = 21, stroke = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#F7F7F7", high = "#7B3294",
      name = "Prop Delayed (%)",
      limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient(
      low = "#F7F7F7", high = "#7B3294",
      guide = "none",
      limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, ratio = 1) +
    labs(title = "D. Proportion Delayed (%) ", x = NULL, y = NULL,
         subtitle = "[Delayed / (Immediate + Delayed)] × 100") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 6, color = "grey50"),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F5F5", color = NA)
    )
  
  # ── Combine 4 panels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fire_panel <- (p1 | p2 | p3 | p4) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title = fire_to_map,
      subtitle = sprintf("n=%d plots | Immediate: %.1f%% | Delayed: %.1f%% | Prop Delayed: %.1f%%",
                        n_plots, mean_immediate, mean_delayed, mean_prop_delayed),
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, family = "Arial"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey40", family = "Arial")
      )
    )
  
  return(fire_panel)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE 3-FIRE SPATIAL FIGURE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fire_panels_spatial <- list()

for (fire_to_map in representative_fires_spatial) {
  panel <- create_fire_spatial_mortality(fire_to_map, map_plot_data)
  if(!is.null(panel)) {
    fire_panels_spatial[[fire_to_map]] <- panel
  }
}

# Combine vertically
fig_spatial_mortality <- wrap_plots(fire_panels_spatial, ncol = 1) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Spatial Patterns of Immediate vs Delayed Canopy Mortality Within Fires",
    subtitle = "Panel D (Prop Delayed) shows where delayed mortality dominates within each fire perimeter",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, family = "Arial", margin = margin(b = 4)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40", family = "Arial", margin = margin(b = 8))
    )
  )

# ── Preview ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig_spatial_mortality

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave(
  "Fig_Spatial_Immediate_vs_Delayed_Mortality_Within_Fires.png",
  plot   = fig_spatial_mortality,
  width  = 14.0,
  height = 12.0,
  dpi    = 300,
  bg     = "white"
)

print("✓ Spatial mortality figure saved!")
```

```{r}
setDT(plots_191)
setDT(plots_175)

cat('=== DATASET COMPARISON ===\n')
cat('plots_191 — fires:', uniqueN(plots_191$Fire_ID),
    '| rows:', nrow(plots_191), '\n')
cat('plots_175 — fires:', uniqueN(plots_175$Fire_ID),
    '| rows:', nrow(plots_175), '\n')

# ── STEP 1: Which fires are in 191 but not in 179? ────────────────────────────
fires_191 <- unique(plots_191$Fire_ID)
fires_175 <- unique(plots_175$Fire_ID)
fires_dropped <- setdiff(fires_191, fires_175)

cat('\n=== FIRES DROPPED (191 → 175) ===\n')
cat('N fires dropped:', length(fires_dropped), '\n')

# Profile dropped fires
dropped_profile <- plots_191[
  Fire_ID %in% fires_dropped &
  Correct_Plot_Label_final %in% c("Burned_clean","Unburned_clean"),
  .(n_burned   = sum(Correct_Plot_Label_final=="Burned_clean"),
    n_unburned = sum(Correct_Plot_Label_final=="Unburned_clean"),
    Fire_Name  = first(Fire_Name)
  ),
  by=Fire_ID
][order(n_burned)]

print(dropped_profile)

cat('\nSummary of dropped fires:\n')
cat('Mean burned plots:', round(mean(dropped_profile$n_burned), 1), '\n')
cat('Fires with <10 burned plots:',
    sum(dropped_profile$n_burned < 10), '\n')
cat('Fires with <10 unburned plots:',
    sum(dropped_profile$n_unburned < 10), '\n')

# ── STEP 2: Within retained fires — plot-level reduction ──────────────────────
# 191-fire usable plots
usable_191 <- plots_191[
  Correct_Plot_Label_final %in% c("Burned_clean","Unburned_clean") &
  Fire_ID %in% fires_175  # same fires only
]

cat('\n=== PLOT-LEVEL REDUCTION (same 175 fires) ===\n')
cat('Plots in 191-fire dataset (175 fires only):\n')
usable_191[, .(n=.N), by=Correct_Plot_Label_final]

cat('\nPlots in final 175-fire dataset:\n')
plots_175[, .(n=.N), by=Correct_Plot_Label_final]

cat('\nDifference (plots present in old data but not in new datA):\n')
plots_not_in_175 <- usable_191[
  !plot_key %in% plots_175$plot_key
][, .(n=.N), by=Correct_Plot_Label_final]
print(plots_not_in_175)

# ── STEP 3: Full exclusion summary for methods reporting ──────────────────────
cat('\n=== FULL EXCLUSION SUMMARY FOR METHODS ===\n')

# All classified plots
n_total_classified <- nrow(plots_191[
  Correct_Plot_Label_final %in% c("Burned_clean","Unburned_clean")
])

# Step-by-step reduction
cat('Starting usable plots (191 fires):',
    n_total_classified, '\n')
cat('  Excluded — fires below minimum plot threshold (<10 FP or BP):',
    n_total_classified -
    nrow(plots_191[
      Correct_Plot_Label_final %in% c("Burned_clean","Unburned_clean") &
      Fire_ID %in% fires_175
    ]), 'plots in', length(fires_dropped), 'fires\n')
cat('  Additional plot-level exclusions within retained fires:',
    nrow(plots_not_in_175[Correct_Plot_Label_final=="Burned_clean",]),
    'FP +',
    nrow(plots_not_in_175[Correct_Plot_Label_final=="Unburned_clean",]),
    'BP\n')
cat('Final analysis dataset: 11,340 FP + 9,335 BP = 20,675 plots | 175 fires\n')

# ── STEP 4: Non-usable plot breakdown in final 179-fire dataset ────────────────
cat('\n=== NON-USABLE PLOT CATEGORIES IN FULL 195-FIRE DATASET ===\n')
plots_191[
  !Correct_Plot_Label_final %in% c("Burned_clean","Unburned_clean")
][, .(
  n   = .N,
  pct = round(100*.N/nrow(plots_191), 1)
), by=Correct_Plot_Label_final][order(-n)] |> print()

cat('\nMethods note:\n')
cat('Plots excluded from analysis due to:\n')
cat('  Will_Burn: temporal confound — burned in subsequent study fire\n')
cat('  Reburned: multiple burn events within study window\n')
```

```{r}
# ✓ CORRECTED: Define plots_to_remove from FULL plots_191
plots_to_remove <- plots_191[
  !plot_key %in% plots_175$plot_key &   # not in new dataset
  Fire_ID %in% fires_175                 # from the 175 retained fires
]

cat("\nTotal to remove:", nrow(plots_to_remove), "\n")

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# NOW RUN THE ANTI-JOIN LOOP
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

dfs_to_clean <- c("master", "plot_metrics_analysis", "dt3", "plot_metrics_final")

cat("\n=== ANTI-JOIN FILTERING ACROSS DATASETS ===\n")

for (df_name in dfs_to_clean) {
  
  if (!exists(df_name)) {
    cat("⚠ WARNING:", df_name, "does not exist. Skipping.\n")
    next
  }
  
  df <- get(df_name)
  
  if (!"plot_key" %in% names(df)) {
    cat("⚠ WARNING:", df_name, "does not have 'plot_key' column. Skipping.\n")
    next
  }
  
  n_before <- nrow(df)
  df_cleaned <- df[!plot_key %in% plots_to_remove$plot_key]
  n_removed <- n_before - nrow(df_cleaned)
  pct_removed <- round(100 * n_removed / n_before, 2)
  
  assign(df_name, df_cleaned, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  cat("✓", df_name, "\n")
  cat("   Before: ", format(n_before, big.mark=","), " rows\n", sep="")
  cat("   After:  ", format(nrow(df_cleaned), big.mark=","), " rows\n", sep="")
  cat("   Removed:", format(n_removed, big.mark=","), 
      "rows (", pct_removed, "%)\n\n", sep="")
}

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SANITY CHECKS
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n=== SANITY CHECKS ===\n")

for (df_name in dfs_to_clean) {
  if (exists(df_name)) {
    df <- get(df_name)
    if ("plot_key" %in% names(df)) {
      overlap <- sum(df$plot_key %in% plots_to_remove$plot_key)
      if (overlap == 0) {
        cat("✓", df_name, ": No flagged plots remain\n")
      } else {
        cat("⚠ WARNING:", df_name, "still contains", overlap, "flagged plots!\n")
      }
    }
  }
}

cat("\n✓ FILTERING COMPLETE\n")
```

Check all data frames to determine which are stale and need to be updated by the sev_plot sev_MT07 data:
```{r}
audit_staleness <- function(df, df_name) {
  has_sev  <- "sev_MT07" %in% names(df)
  has_dnbr <- "dNBR" %in% names(df)
  
  if (!("plot_key" %in% names(df))) {
    return(data.frame(object = df_name, note = "no plot_key column — check manually"))
  }
  
  check <- df %>%
    select(plot_key, any_of(c("sev_MT07", "dNBR"))) %>%
    distinct(plot_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    inner_join(reference, by = "plot_key")
  
  sev_mismatch <- if (has_sev) {
    sum(as.character(check$sev_MT07) != as.character(check$sev_MT07_correct), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else NA
  
  dnbr_mismatch <- if (has_dnbr) {
    sum(abs(check$dNBR - check$dNBR_correct) > 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else NA
  
  data.frame(
    object = df_name,
    n_rows_in_df = nrow(distinct(df, plot_key)),
    n_matched_to_reference = nrow(check),
    n_missing_from_reference = nrow(distinct(df, plot_key)) - nrow(check),
    sev_MT07_mismatches = sev_mismatch,
    dNBR_mismatches = dnbr_mismatch
  )
}

audit_results <- bind_rows(
  audit_staleness(plot_metrics_analysis, "plot_metrics_analysis"),
  audit_staleness(dt3, "dt3"),
  audit_staleness(master, "master"),
  audit_staleness(plot_metrics_final, "plot_metrics_final")
)

print(audit_results)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

burned_long <- master %>% filter(Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean")

# ── 1. Baseline: mean TRE over years -5..-1 (manuscript definition) ──
baseline_final <- burned_long %>%
  filter(delta_year >= -5, delta_year <= -1) %>%
  group_by(plot_key) %>%
  summarise(baseline_final = mean(TRE, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_baseline_years = sum(!is.na(TRE)),     # flag plots with < 5 pre-fire years
            .groups = "drop")

# ── 2. Year-1 canopy and the years 1-10 minimum ──
yr1 <- burned_long %>%
  filter(delta_year == 1) %>%
  group_by(plot_key) %>%
  summarise(canopy_yr1 = mean(TRE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

min_dt <- burned_long %>%
  filter(delta_year >= 1, delta_year <= 10, !is.na(TRE)) %>%
  group_by(plot_key) %>%
  summarise(min_canopy = min(TRE),
            min_year   = delta_year[which.min(TRE)], .groups = "drop")

# ── 3. Loss variables (master's sign convention: IFL/PAL negative = loss) ──
derived <- baseline_final %>%
  inner_join(yr1, by = "plot_key") %>%
  inner_join(min_dt, by = "plot_key") %>%
  mutate(
    IFL            = canopy_yr1 - baseline_final,   # signed
    PAL            = min_canopy  - canopy_yr1,      # signed
    IFL_loss       = pmax(-IFL, 0),                 # floored magnitude
    PAL_loss       = pmax(-PAL, 0),
    total_loss     = IFL_loss + PAL_loss,
    total_loss_rel = if_else(baseline_final > 0, 100 * total_loss / baseline_final, NA_real_),
    prop_delayed   = if_else(total_loss > 0, PAL_loss / total_loss, NA_real_),
    class_4_new    = case_when(
      total_loss_rel <= 50 & prop_delayed <= 0.50 ~ "Low loss- Immediate dominant",
      total_loss_rel <= 50 & prop_delayed >  0.50 ~ "Low loss- Delayed dominant",
      total_loss_rel >  50 & prop_delayed <= 0.50 ~ "High loss- Immediate dominant",
      total_loss_rel >  50 & prop_delayed >  0.50 ~ "High loss- Delayed dominant",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  )
# ── 4. Identity check: must be ~0 for every plot ──
summary(abs(derived$resid_cc <- derived$min_canopy - (derived$baseline_final + derived$IFL + derived$PAL)))
```

```{r}
  filter(Correct_Plot_Label_final == "Burned_clean") %>%
  distinct(plot_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    IFL_loss = IFL_loss,     # corrected floored magnitudes
    PAL_loss = PAL_loss
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("TRE", "year", "delta_year", "key", "resid_cc",
                   "IFL", "PAL",                    # signed columns don't belong in the per-plot analysis frame
                   "TRE_prefire", "class_4", "mortality_class_final"))) %>%
  mutate(class_4_clean = case_when(
    class_4_new == "High loss- Delayed dominant"   ~ "high_delayed",
    class_4_new == "High loss- Immediate dominant" ~ "high_immediate",
    class_4_new == "Low loss- Delayed dominant"    ~ "low_delayed",
    class_4_new == "Low loss- Immediate dominant"  ~ "low_immediate",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_))

names(plot_metrics_analysis)
names(master)
# 3. Save as a new versioned file; keep the old one for provenance
fwrite(as.data.frame(master), "Master_AllFires_179_2026_09_27.csv")
fwrite(as.data.frame(plot_metrics_analysis), "Plot_Metrics_Analysis_2026_09_27.csv")
```
